bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ingiza mikono yako ndani yake, na tayari! Unabaki ukielea!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It's Mabel! She tied a string to herself, binding herself to you. Now she's riding securely in your pack.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ni Mabel! Amejifunga kamba, akajifunga nawe. Sasa amekaa kwa usalama kwenye mkoba wako.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: You know what they say. One critter’s lace, is another critter’s bondage rope~!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Unajua wanavyosema. Kamba ya kiatu ya mnyama mmoja ni kamba ya ufungaji wa kimapenzi ya mwingine~!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Issue 68. Mint condition! Save for a recent stain… definitely not saliva.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Toleo la 68. Hali bora kabisa! Isipokuwa doa la karibuni… hakika si mate.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Wear this in icy places, and cold can’t even touch you! Looks super styley too.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Vaa hii sehemu zenye barafu, na baridi haitakugusa hata kidogo! Pia inapendeza sana.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A box of Finley's stuff he left with his old roommates. Looks like some papers, paintbrushes, and a few bedroom toys.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sanduku la vitu vya Finley alivyoviacha kwa watu waliowahi kushiriki makazi naye. Kunaonekana kuwa na karatasi, brashi za kupaka rangi, na vifaa vichache vya ngono.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A sturdy building material, just perfect for reinforcing heavy structures like the town bridge…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Nyenzo imara ya ujenzi, inayofaa kabisa kuimarisha miundo mizito kama daraja la mji…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A glass jar containing the "seed of a wolf." A tribe of forest mice asked you to obtain it for a peculiar ceremony...
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi wa kioo wenye "mbegu za mbwa-mwitu." Kabila la panya wa msituni limekuomba uzipate kwa ajili ya sherehe ya ajabu...

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ina mikunjo yote inayofaa, na unene wa kutosha kukujaza kwelikweli!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A classic, practical tool for excavating and outdoor projects. Surprisingly, shovels are hard to come by in this forest!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Zana ya kawaida na yenye manufaa ya kuchimba na kufanya kazi za nje. Cha ajabu, makoleo ni nadra kupatikana katika msitu huu!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies that makes a great lantern. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi wa vimulimuli vichangamfu unaofaa sana kuwa taa. Ungependa kutazama kinachoendelea humo ndani, lakini vinazunguka kwa kasi mno!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi wa vimulimuli vichangamfu. Ungependa kutazama kinachoendelea humo ndani, lakini vinazunguka kwa kasi mno!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kengele hii itamwita Penny kwenye kituo cha kutua cha safari za haraka cha Msitu wa Kati!
Kengele ya Safari ya Msitu wa Kati
Kengele ya Safari ya Msitu wa Kati

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A bottle of ’Sugar’ … an ingredient Scarlett's never been out of her entire life!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Chupa ya ’Sukari’ … kiungo ambacho Scarlett hajawahi kukosa maishani mwake!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Some warm fluffy wool from Finley. Perfect sweater-making material!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sufu laini yenye joto kutoka kwa Finley. Nyenzo inayofaa kabisa kutengenezea sweta!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A musty piece of wood to the layman. A blank canvas to the artisan.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kwa mtu wa kawaida, ni kipande cha mbao chenye harufu ya uvundo. Kwa fundi msanii, ni turubai tupu ya kufanyia kazi.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Peter. The wearer might spot "very interesting things…"
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Zawadi kutoka kwa Peter. Anayeivaa huenda akaona "mambo ya kuvutia sana…"

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A heavy package for Scarlett. Contains two ball gags, one riders crop, two pairs of handcuffs and a full range of anal plugs…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kifurushi kizito cha Scarlett. Kina viziba mdomo viwili vya mipira, mjeledi mmoja wa kupandia farasi, jozi mbili za pingu na mkusanyiko kamili wa vizibo vya mkundu…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sweet and delicious! You’d snack on these all day if you could!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ni tamu na ladha yake ni nzuri! Ungezila hizi siku nzima kama ungeweza!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: (Usable) A series of steamy photographs of Melody from a secret modeling session in Maverick's back-room studio.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: (Inaweza Kutumiwa) Mfululizo wa picha motomoto za Melody kutoka kwenye kipindi cha siri cha kupiga pozi katika studio ya chumba cha nyuma cha Maverick.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi wa vimulimuli vichangamfu. Ungependa kutazama kinachoendelea humo ndani, lakini vinazunguka kwa kasi mno!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sharp and shiny, these salutary scissors are suitable for all sorts of shearing shenanigans.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mkasi huu mkali unaong'aa ni msaada mzuri kwa michezo ya kila namna ya kunyoa.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A light package for Augustus. Contains an ancient relic of some sort.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kifurushi chepesi cha Augustus. Kina kitu fulani cha kale kilichosalia.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kwa msafiri wetu aliyechoka~ Pona haraka! Tuna hamu ya kukutana nawe! Ukurasa unaofuata umejaa sahihi na alama za nyayo.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Scarlett. This nifty atlas helps travelers navigate the forest! Activate it with [M] or [Select].
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Zawadi kutoka kwa Scarlett. Atlasi hii nzuri huwasaidia wasafiri kujua njia za msituni! Ifungue kwa [M] au [Select].

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Lake fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kengele hii itamwita Penny kwenye kituo cha kutua cha safari za haraka cha Ziwa!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A handy notebook that gives you access to the Critter Log, the Quest Log, and Gossiping with Critters!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Daftari lenye manufaa linalokupa ufikiaji wa Daftari la Wanyama, Daftari la Misheni, na Porojo na Wanyama!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi tupu wa kioo. Unaweza kubebea vitu vya kufurahisha vya kila namna ndani yake!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: During some Adventures, your other items are stored in the background. You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Katika baadhi ya Matukio ya Kusisimua, vitu vyako vingine huhifadhiwa kando. Utaviona tena Tukio la Kusisimua litakapomalizika!
Kitu cha Muda cha Tukio la Kusisimua

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Mountain fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kengele hii itamwita Penny kwenye kituo cha kutua cha safari za haraka cha Mlima!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A scrumptious red apple from the tree near the northern mountains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tofaa jekundu tamu sana kutoka kwenye mti ulio karibu na milima ya kaskazini.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Plains fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kengele hii itamwita Penny kwenye kituo cha kutua cha safari za haraka cha Nyanda!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Tournament legal, professional-grade, wood and carbon fiber. A proper endgame-spanker.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Inaruhusiwa katika mashindano, ya kiwango cha kitaalamu, ya mbao na nyuzi za kaboni. Kifaa cha mwisho kabisa cha kuchapia makalio.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mtungi tupu wa kioo. Unaweza kubebea vitu vya kufurahisha vya kila namna ndani yake!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Expert Craftsmanship, a touch of Southern Comfort, and a heavy dose of Adult Innovation.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ufundi wa Kitaalamu, kidogo cha Southern Comfort, na ubunifu mwingi wa Watu Wazima.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Part of a cookie Mabel couldn't finish. It's as sweet as the others, but moreso because you got to share it with her.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sehemu ya biskuti ambayo Mabel alishindwa kumaliza. Ni tamu kama zile nyingine, lakini tamu zaidi kwa sababu uliishiriki naye.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Friendship cookies! Piping fresh and ready to go. These sugary snacks will surely help break the ice!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Biskuti za urafiki! Zimeokwa hivi punde na ziko tayari kupelekwa. Vitafunio hivi vya sukari hakika vitasaidia kuanza kuzoeana!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Fully Adjustable, Customizable. Recommended use with silicone toys only.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Inaweza kurekebishwa na kubinafsishwa kikamilifu. Inapendekezwa kutumia na vifaa vya silikoni pekee.
Mshipi wa Kufungia Kifaa cha Ngono
Mshipi wa Kufungia Kifaa cha Ngono

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Augustus. It might help to decipher glyphs around the forest.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Zawadi kutoka kwa Augustus. Huenda ikasaidia kufasiri alama za maandishi zilizoko msituni.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Maverick. It's definitely broken, but it’s still an amusing conversation piece.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Zawadi kutoka kwa Maverick. Hakika imeharibika, lakini bado ni kitu cha kufurahisha cha kuanzishia mazungumzo.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A professional camera with a wide angle lens. Essential equipment for any kind of studio photography.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kamera ya kitaalamu yenye lenzi ya pembe pana. Kifaa muhimu kwa upigaji picha wa studio wa kila namna.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A special friendship cookie for Finley to help his old roommates make amends. The icing spells out "We're Sorry".
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Biskuti maalumu ya urafiki kwa Finley ili kuwasaidia watu waliowahi kushiriki makazi naye kuomba radhi. Maandishi ya krimu yake yanasema "We're Sorry" (Tunaomba Radhi).

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Ollie. It doesn't seem particularly lucky, but it was still thoughtful of him!

Mwenye Kushiriki Mwenza Wake na Wengine

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Got some explorin’ to do! Not sure what I want yet -- but I'm sure you can help me find it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Nina mambo ya kujaribu! Bado sijui ninachotaka -- lakini nina hakika unaweza kunisaidia kukipata!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Gather some critters for sexy shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kusanya wanyama fulani kwa michezo ya ngono katika gereza la chini la sungura.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Mabel remember what really happened during her last Blessing of the Bells.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Msaidie Mabel kukumbuka yaliyotokea kweli katika Baraka za Kengele alizosherehekea mara ya mwisho.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Thanks for helping out today, Red. The critters and I really appreciate it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Asante kwa kusaidia leo, Mwekundu. Mimi na wanyama tunakushukuru sana!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Track down an elusive wolf to collect an important ingredient for the mouse ceremony.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Mtafute mbwa-mwitu asiyeonekana kirahisi upate kiungo muhimu cha sherehe ya panya.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Melody has an idea where you might find an extra greeting card from last year's Blessing. See if you can track it down!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Melody ana wazo la mahali unapoweza kupata kadi ya salamu ya ziada ya Baraka za mwaka jana. Jaribu kuitafuta!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Wind from the Big Storm scattered Melody's photoshoot photos around in the forest! Help Maverick find them all.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Upepo wa Dhoruba Kubwa umetawanya picha za kipindi cha upigaji picha cha Melody msituni! Msaidie Maverick kuzipata zote.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: What exactly is the Blessing Of The Bells? See if some of the forest critters can tell you more!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Baraka za Kengele ni nini hasa? Angalia kama baadhi ya wanyama wa msituni wanaweza kukuambia zaidi!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Sonny, ya familiar with PlayBear? I’d love to get my paws on a copy!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kijana, unalijua Playbear? Ningependa sana kupata nakala!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Join Mabel's tribe in an ancient ceremony to quell the "spirit of the forest."
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Jiunge na kabila la Mabel katika sherehe ya kale ya kuituliza "roho ya msitu."

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: I need a new toy, but not just ANY toy, it has to NOT look like a toy. Understand?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Nahitaji kifaa kipya cha ngono, lakini si kifaa CHOCHOTE tu, LAZIMA kisifanane na kifaa cha ngono. Unaelewa?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Check up on the critters after yesterday's big storm!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Wajulie hali wanyama baada ya dhoruba kubwa ya jana!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Search the forest for a light source to visit Mabel's folks.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tafuta chanzo cha mwanga msituni ili uitembelee jamii ya Mabel.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Maverick's been harvesting Oliver's seed and carrying it away. But why? And why does he need so much?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Maverick amekuwa akikusanya mbegu za Oliver na kuzipeleka. Lakini kwa nini? Na anahitaji nyingi hivyo kwa nini?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Trade Ollie some apples for a ride across the Plains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Mpe Ollie matofaa kwa kubadilishana na usafiri wa kuvuka Nyanda.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Find the plant and bring back some special 'seed' for Scarlett.
Deliver cookies from Charlotte to all the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Wapelekee wanyama wote wa msituni biskuti za Charlotte.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Go find a few critters Scarlett wants you to meet.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Nenda ukatafute wanyama wachache ambao Scarlett anataka ukutane nao.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source:
While you're playing an Adventure, your other quests are stored in the background.

You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target:
Unapocheza Tukio la Kusisimua, misheni zako nyingine huhifadhiwa kando.

Utaziona tena Tukio la Kusisimua litakapomalizika!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Bucky gather building materials to fix the town bridge.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Msaidie Bucky kukusanya vifaa vya ujenzi vya kutengeneza daraja la mji.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: There's a rope-oriented bondage I’d like to try! Can you help me find ropes my size?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kuna mchezo wa ufungaji wa kimapenzi kwa kamba ningependa kujaribu! Unaweza kunisaidia kupata kamba za ukubwa unaonifaa?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: It's the ladies' turn! Gather a few frisky females for more shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ni zamu ya wanawake! Kusanya wanawake wachache wenye hamu ya mapenzi kwa michezo mingine katika gereza la chini la sungura.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Meet the critters and fetch some sugar for Scarlett.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kutana na wanyama ukamletee Scarlett sukari.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help the coyotes knit you a cozy warm sweater.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Wasaidie koyoti wakufumie sweta yenye joto na starehe.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Maverick deliver some curious items to the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Msaidie Maverick kuwapelekea wanyama wa msituni vitu fulani vya ajabu.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Finley close the loop with his old roommates.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Msaidie Finley kusuluhisha mambo na watu waliowahi kushiriki makazi naye.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help the forest critters weather a fierce, wild thunderstorm rolling through the neighborhood!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Wasaidie wanyama wa msituni kustahimili dhoruba kali ya radi inayopita katika makazi yao!
Misheni ya Karamu Kubwa ya Vuli

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Maverick find someone to model in his steamy afterdark photoshoot.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Msaidie Maverick kupata mtu wa kupigwa picha kama mwanamitindo katika kipindi chake motomoto cha baada ya giza kuingia.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/ywABHhAT.source:
Ay pal! What
can I do

Well met,

Hujambo rafiki,

ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, honey, I’ve been craving panda… Think you can help?
ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona mpenzi, nimekuwa nikitamani panda… Unaweza kunisaidia?

ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What a day! Thanks so much for helping out, sweetie~!
ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siku gani hii! Asante sana kwa kusaidia, mpenzi~!

ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… oh me? You didn’t get to help me out? Nonsense! I’m happy seeing my neighbors happy!
ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… oh, mimi? Hukupata kunisaidia mimi? Acha hizo! Ninafurahi kuwaona majirani wangu wakifurahi!

ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]If you aren’t too tired… There is definitely something you can help me out with…
ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ikiwa hujachoka sana… Hakika kuna kitu unachoweza kunisaidia…

ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I should visit this area more often. It’s very relaxing and I love the river ambiance!
ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ninapaswa kuja eneo hili mara nyingi zaidi. Linatuliza sana na napenda sauti za mto!

ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey, I don’t know if you eat fish… but the fish here… don’t like to be eaten… This was news to me.
ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hujambo, sijui kama unakula samaki… lakini samaki wa hapa… hawapendi kuliwa… Hilo lilikuwa jambo jipya kwangu.

ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm… part of me wants to update my dam into something a bit more presentable…
ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm… kwa upande mmoja, ninataka kuboresha bwawa langu lionekane vizuri zaidi…

ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lot of the woodwork around town was done by me!
ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kazi nyingi za mbao hapa mjini zimefanywa na mimi!

ds:106:126:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But the other part of me digs the rustic feel!
ds:106:126:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini kwa upande mwingine, napenda mwonekano wake wa kijijini!

ds:106:127:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m just happy to see my work appreciated!

ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]These old bones can’t quite keep up these days!
ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mifupa hii mizee haiwezi kuhimili kama zamani siku hizi!

ds:106:129:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*Yawwwwn* ah… I could go for a nap right about now…
ds:106:129:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]*Anapigaaa miayo* ah… Ningependa kulala kidogo sasa hivi…

ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s hard work running a shop, Red! Hard but gratifyin’.
ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kuendesha duka ni kazi ngumu, Mwekundu! Ngumu lakini inaridhisha.

ds:107:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]They’d love to fool around with you!

ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re always lookin’ for a good pair of paws to help out though! Keep us in mind!
ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hata hivyo, daima tunatafuta jozi ya mikono hodari ya kutusaidia! Utukumbuke!

ds:107:119:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Remind me to introduce you to the gang later!

ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! You’ve got a cute butt. Just sayin’. The view down here is great.
ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mwekundu! Una makalio mazuri. Nimesema tu. Mandhari kutoka huku chini inapendeza.

ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]By the way, if you wanted to try that sounding stuff… I’m your mouse~!
ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pia, ukitaka kujaribu mambo yale ya kuingiza fimbo kwenye mrija wa mkojo… Mimi ndiye panya wako~!

ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.source: Is this the collapse of society and civilization as we know it?
ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.target: Je, huku ndiko kuporomoka kwa jamii na ustaarabu tunaoufahamu?

ds:111:9:Menu Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, how can I help you?

ds:115:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m kidding, you know you’re always welcome inside.

ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]HOWEVER, I haven’t had a chance to tidy up. So you can’t come in yet.
ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]HATA HIVYO, sijapata nafasi ya kupanga nyumba. Kwa hiyo bado huwezi kuingia.

ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Red sweetie, I’m being serious, you can’t go inside.
ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mwekundu mpenzi, sisemi utani, huwezi kuingia ndani.

ds:115:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I refuse to play your childish games!

ds:115:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… *Her glare pierces your heart and soul*
ds:115:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… *Anakutazama kwa ukali unaopenya moyo na roho yako*

ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.source: The overwhelming amount of guilt stops you from entering the house.
ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.target: Hisia nyingi mno za hatia zinakuzuia kuingia nyumbani.

ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.source: Trespassing? You’re not that kinda panda.
ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.target: Kuingia bila ruhusa? Wewe si panda wa aina hiyo.

ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.source: Wouldn’t wanna be this bridge right now!
ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.target: Nisingependa kuwa daraja hili sasa hivi!

ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.source: When this bridge grew up, it could be anything.
ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.target: Daraja hili lilipokuwa linakua, lingeweza kuwa chochote.

ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.source: Is it still called a bridge if it doesn’t function as one?
ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.target: Bado linaitwa daraja ikiwa halifanyi kazi ya daraja?

ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.source: It seems there has been an incline in bridge-related violence in these parts.
ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.target: Inaonekana vurugu zinazohusu madaraja zimepanda huku.

ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.source: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE
ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.target: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE

ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.source: He was definitely my first in terms of big partners!
ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.target: Hakika alikuwa mwenza wangu wa kwanza kati ya wenza wakubwa!

ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm that stretched feeling, with his hulking weight over me…
ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, ile hisia ya kutanuliwa, huku uzito wa mwili wake mkubwa ukiwa juu yangu…

ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.source: It was exhilarating really! And I loved the challenge!
ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.target: Ilisisimua sana kweli! Na nilifurahia changamoto!

ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.source: Over time, I was finally able to hilt him. GOSH what a good feeling!
ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.target: Baada ya muda, hatimaye niliweza kuupokea uume wake wote. JAMANI, raha yake!

ds:119:138:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal, will ya give us a minute?

ds:119:139:Dialogue Text.source: Peter likes his post coitus cuddles!
ds:119:139:Dialogue Text.target: Peter anapenda kukumbatiana baada ya ngono!

ds:119:2:Dialogue Text.target: *anahema hema* Aisee mpenzi, wewe ni wa ajabu!

ds:119:321:Dialogue Text.source: Come on in honey. Take a seat on the bed…

ds:119:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, are we doing sex stuff?

ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yes. How’s that for a proper thank you
ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, ndiyo. Unaonaje hiyo kama shukrani kamili

ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m probably a bit too big for you…
ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.target: Lakini labda mimi ni mkubwa mno kwako…

ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, Rascal… The critters here will surprise you with what they are capable of.
ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.target: Hah, Rascal… Wanyama wa hapa watakushangaza kwa wanachoweza kufanya.

ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.source: That said, I’ll just be doing some mouth stuff.
ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.target: Hata hivyo, nitafanya mambo ya mdomo tu.

ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve been wanting to see what ya got going on down there…
ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.target: Nimekuwa nikitaka kuona ulicho nacho huko chini…

ds:119:329:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, and look how excited you are already…

ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.source: Ah hah… I blame the recent plant activities…
ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.target: Ah hah… Nayalaumu mambo ya mmea ya hivi karibuni…

ds:119:331:Dialogue Text.source: Lay back, let me get a taste…

ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lays back and lets the eager bunny get to work…
ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal analala chali na kumruhusu sungura mwenye hamu aanze kazi…

ds:119:3:Dialogue Text.target: *anacheka kwa sauti ndogo* Unataka kuonja, Peter?

ds:11:18:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa! Is there something hidden here??

ds:120:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve let all of the critters know you’re awake.

ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well, almost all of them, but word travels fast here…
ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Naam, karibu wote, lakini habari husambaa haraka hapa…

ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So tell me. What is it you’re here for?
ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basi niambie. Umekuja hapa kwa ajili ya nini?

ds:120:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Mmmm. I think I know what you’re gettin’ at.

ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, you’re not the first fella comin’ ‘round here to sleep around!
ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, wewe si wa kwanza kuja hapa kutafuta wenza wa kulala nao!

ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can imagine what you may have heard about our little town…
ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Naweza kuwaza uliyoyasikia kuhusu mji wetu mdogo…

ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But unfortunately, it doesn’t quite live up to the rumors.
ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini kwa bahati mbaya, si kama uvumi unavyosema hasa.

ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’see, we’ve all got things to do and lives to lead.
ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona, sote tuna mambo ya kufanya na maisha ya kuishi.

ds:120:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t possibly expect us to be bangin’ about all day!

ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Who’ll put dinner on the table? Who’ll fetch supplies for the town? Who’ll fix the broken bridge?
ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Nani atatayarisha chakula cha jioni? Nani atauletea mji mahitaji? Nani atatengeneza daraja lililovunjika?

ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See, we’re just a town like anywhere else.
ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Unaona, sisi ni mji kama mingine tu.

ds:120:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]THOUGH that’s not to say we don’t have our fun!

ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In fact! Now that I know that’s what you’re after, I can fill everyone else in…
ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kwa kweli! Sasa kwa kuwa najua hicho ndicho unachotafuta, ninaweza kuwajulisha wengine wote…

ds:120:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, let me fill ya in on how things work around here.

ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this above a critter’s head, it means they have something important to tell ya!
ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ukiona hii juu ya kichwa cha mnyama, maana yake ana jambo muhimu la kukuambia!

ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]If you see this, it means they’re waiting on you for something.
ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ukiona hii, maana yake anasubiri ufanye kitu.

ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this, it means you’ve got something for them!
ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ukiona hii, maana yake una kitu cha kumpa!

ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Lastly, when you see this, it means a critter has more to say on the topic.
ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mwisho, ukiona hii, maana yake mnyama ana mengi zaidi ya kusema kuhusu mada hiyo.

ds:120:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes this is where the juicy stuff is!
ds:120:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Wakati mwingine hapo ndipo mambo ya kusisimua yalipo!

ds:120:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]While you’re out and about, pick me up some sugar from Maverick!
ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unapozunguka huko, niletee sukari kutoka kwa Maverick!

ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Straight to the point! You’re my kinda panda dear~
ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unaenda moja kwa moja kwenye jambo! Wewe ni panda wa aina ninayoipenda, mpenzi~

ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And by the looks of ya down below, you’re just my size too!
ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Na kwa ninavyoona huko chini kwako, ukubwa wako unanifaa kabisa pia!

ds:120:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… Lakini hilo ni la wakati mwingine!

ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]He’s the otter by the river. You’ll know him when ya see em!
ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Yeye ndiye fisi maji aliye kando ya mto. Utamtambua ukimwona!

ds:120:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ohhh, look, I’m not on “good terms” with the fella that lives on that island.
ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ohhh, ona, mimi na yule anayeishi kwenye kisiwa hicho hatuko kwenye “maelewano mazuri.”

ds:121:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tuna… aah, mambo ya zamani kati yetu.

ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But this is an urgent matter… The town’s needs come first…
ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini hili ni jambo la haraka… Mahitaji ya mji yanatangulia…

ds:121:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Unless… You learn how to swim by then?
ds:121:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isipokuwa… Utakuwa umejifunza kuogelea kufikia wakati huo?

ds:121:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nooo no. I’ll do it, I’ll do it…

ds:121:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hehe, it’s a bit old fashioned I suppose…
ds:121:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hehe, nadhani hiyo ni tabia ya kizamani kidogo…

ds:121:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal – didja’ get the wood I need?

ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, I recall there being some on the island in the middle of the lake.
ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unajua, nakumbuka kulikuwa na nyingine kwenye kisiwa kilicho katikati ya ziwa.

ds:121:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That might be enough to get us going here.

ds:121:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh but… you can’t swim that huh…
ds:121:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, lakini… huwezi kuogelea umbali huo, sivyo…

ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The big ole’ gator and I used to date some time ago.
ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mimi na yule aligeta mkubwa mzee tulikuwa tukikutana kimapenzi zamani.

ds:121:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some things change, while other things don’t…

ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve never been one to confront emotional or social problems.
ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sijawahi kuwa mtu wa kukabiliana na matatizo ya kihisia au kijamii.

ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m more of the: “bury things deep down until they disappear forever” kinda guy, y’know?
ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mimi ni wa aina ya: “yazike ndani kabisa hadi yapotee milele,” unajua?

ds:122:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! What’s shakin’? How can I be of service?

ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Can you swim across the lake
to the island for me?
ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Unaweza kuogelea kuvuka ziwa
kwenda kisiwani kwa niaba yangu?

ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]BUT, why would I swim FOR you? When I can HELP you swim across that lake instead?!
ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]LAKINI, kwa nini niogelee KWA NIABA YAKO? Wakati ninaweza KUKUSAIDIA wewe kuvuka ziwa hilo ukiogelea badala yake?!

ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well, I won’t technically help you. I’m not gonna teach you or anything.
ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Naam, kusema kweli sitakusaidia. Sitakufundisha wala chochote kama hicho.

ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No. Instead. I’ve got a couple of floaties for sale!
ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]La. Badala yake. Nina vifaa viwili vya kuelea vya kuuza!

ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, you slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Unaona, unaingiza mikono yako ndani yake, na tayari! Unabaki ukielea!

ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So long as they don’t… pop… you should be fine…
ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mradi tu visi… pasuke… natarajia utakuwa salama…

ds:122:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ahem, So we got a deal or what?

ds:122:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll sell em to ya for 2 coins!

ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well JUST THIS ONCE, I’ll settle for a trade! Because we’re buds, Red.
ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naam, MARA HII TU, nitakubali kubadilishana! Kwa sababu sisi ni marafiki, Mwekundu.

ds:122:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]What do you have that might interest me, Red?

ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red, my guy. I do not do sexual favors as business transactions!
ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mwekundu, rafiki yangu. Sifanyi huduma za ngono kama miamala ya biashara!

ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I keep work and pleasure very separate, you understand, my friend.
ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ninatenganisha kazi na raha kabisa, unaelewa rafiki yangu.

ds:122:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ingawa kwa kweli hazina thamani yoyote kwangu.

ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]HOWEVER, a skilled craftsman can make me something with that!
ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]HATA HIVYO, fundi stadi anaweza kunitengenezea kitu kwa hizo!

ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Tell ya what Red – Tell Bucky to make me "somethin’ fun" with that.
ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Basi hivi Mwekundu – Mwambie Bucky anitengenezee "kitu cha kufurahisha" kwa hizo.

ds:122:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Once he has, I’ll trade ya for these floaties!
ds:122:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Akimaliza, nitakupa vifaa hivi vya kuelea kwa kubadilishana nacho!

ds:123:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, what can I do for ya?

ds:123:159:Dialogue Text.source: Can you sculpt “something fun” for Maverick?

ds:123:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I know exactly what tickles that critter!

ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!
ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nipe muda kidogo, nitakutengenezea kitu mara moja!

ds:123:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!
ds:123:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nipe muda kidogo, nitakutengenezea kitu mara moja!

ds:124:178:Dialogue Text.source: Yes, What do you think of this toy?
ds:124:178:Dialogue Text.target: Ndiyo, unaonaje kifaa hiki cha ngono?

ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh wow. Yes, this is truly the work of a craftsman.
ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, aisee. Ndiyo, hakika hii ni kazi ya fundi stadi.

ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]*Sniff sniff* Mmm, it’s got that new dildo smell, Red - ya gotta get a whiff!
ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]*Ananusa mara mbili* Mmm, ina ile harufu ya dildo mpya, Mwekundu - lazima uinuse!

ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh man what a beauty… I can’t wait to put this in places.
ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Jamani, uzuri gani huu… Nina hamu ya kuiingiza sehemu mbalimbali.

ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well! A deal is a deal Red, one pair of swimfloaties coming right up!
ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Naam! Makubaliano ni makubaliano, Mwekundu, jozi moja ya vifaa vya kuelea inakuja sasa hivi!

ds:124:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red do you have much experience with toys?
ds:124:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mwekundu, una uzoefu mwingi wa vifaa vya ngono?

ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re cut from the same cloth my friend, very good very good.
ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sisi ni wa aina moja rafiki yangu, vizuri sana, vizuri sana.

ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Bucky’s The best in the business, I promise!
ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bucky ndiye bora zaidi katika ufundi huu, nakuhakikishia!

ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve never seen such care and creativity in craftsmanship!
ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sijawahi kuona umakini na ubunifu namna hii katika ufundi!

ds:135:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, you do get a kick out of that eh?

ds:135:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah there’s a lot of room in there… and I’m pretty gentle…
ds:135:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ndiyo, kuna nafasi nyingi humo ndani… na mimi ni mpole sana…

ds:135:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s an absolute THRILL! You gotta try it sometime!

ds:135:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s right! Ole Bucky and I have buried the hatchet!
ds:135:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ndiyo! Mimi na mzee Bucky tumemaliza uhasama!

ds:135:346:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We won’t be getting back together of course, but we’re going to be mature about the past, and move forward.
ds:135:346:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bila shaka haturudiani kimapenzi, lakini tutayakabili yaliyopita kwa ukomavu na kusonga mbele.

ds:135:349:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, we’ve been talking and we’ve come to realize that, though we aren’t right for each other, things definitely didn’t have to get bad between us.
ds:135:349:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unaona, tumekuwa tukizungumza na tumetambua kwamba, ingawa hatuendani kimapenzi, mambo hayakulazimika kuwa mabaya kati yetu.

ds:135:350:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]In the heat of the moment, it can be a tough pill to swallow… But the time apart has really helped us see clearly.
ds:135:350:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Wakati hisia zikiwa zimepanda, inaweza kuwa vigumu kukubali hilo… Lakini muda tuliokaa mbali umetusaidia sana kuona mambo wazi.

ds:135:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Now frankly, I’m just glad to have my friend back!
ds:135:351:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sasa kusema kweli, nimefurahi tu kumpata rafiki yangu tena!

ds:135:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s soooo warm and squishy! Once ya get him drooling, it’s a real mess!
ds:135:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kuna jotooo na ulaini mwingi! Ukimfanya aanze kudondosha mate, kunakuwa na vurugu kweli!

ds:135:358:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, it was quite lonely. I don’t really have much in common with the younger folks these days…
ds:135:358:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kwa kweli, kulikuwa na upweke mwingi. Sina mambo mengi ya pamoja na vijana wa siku hizi…

ds:135:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And if I’m gonna be honest too… I’ve really missed that big ole tongue of yours…
ds:135:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na nami nikisema kweli… Nimeukosa sana ule ulimi wako mkubwa…

ds:135:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh? You missed me regaling the world’s histories to you?

ds:135:367:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, I know ole’ chap. I’ve missed that little rump of yours as well…
ds:135:367:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, najua mzee mwenzangu. Nami nimeyakosa makalio yako madogo pia…

ds:135:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Er.. Ahem! Sorry Rascal… Didn’t mean to get all mushy in front of you…
ds:135:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aah.. Ahem! Samahani Rascal… Sikukusudia kuwa na hisia nyingi namna hii mbele yako…

ds:135:370:Dialogue Text.source:
Not a problem!
I’ll let ya guys get to it!

ds:136:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So back to the original idea then?

ds:136:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I definitely think that’s our lightning in a bottle!
ds:136:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hakika nadhani huo ndio mpango wetu wa kipekee wa kufanikiwa!

ds:136:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wanna hear our next million dollar idea? Don’t steal it!
ds:136:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Unataka kusikia wazo letu linalofuata la dola milioni? Usiliibe!

ds:136:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya ever get tired getting off to the same old same old?
ds:136:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huwa huchoki kujiridhisha kwa mambo yaleyale ya siku zote?

ds:136:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, we should add a matching service as well! We can take notes of kinks, and offer to hook up others interested in similar stuff!
ds:136:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, tuongeze huduma ya kuwaunganisha watu pia! Tunaweza kurekodi mapendeleo ya ngono, na kuwasaidia wenye mapendeleo yanayofanana kukutana!

ds:136:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh that’s good stuff right there! Perhaps we could set up meets for the more popular kinks! We can even feature guests who’re enthusiasts!
ds:136:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh, hilo ni wazo zuri kweli! Labda tunaweza kuandaa mikutano ya mapendeleo ya ngono yanayopendwa zaidi! Tunaweza hata kuwakaribisha wageni wanaoyapenda sana!

ds:136:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That would be a great way for folks to learn about new experiences!
ds:136:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hiyo ingekuwa njia nzuri ya watu kujifunza kuhusu mambo mapya ya kujaribu!

ds:136:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Something tells me, they might just turn into orgies…
ds:136:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nahisi hiyo mikutano inaweza kugeuka tu kuwa ngono za vikundi…

ds:136:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Want some spice in your love life?
ds:136:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unataka kuongeza ladha katika maisha yako ya mapenzi?

ds:136:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look no further! The Kink Finders have your back!

ds:136:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ndiyo! Huu ndio mradi wetu wa karibuni tulioubuni pamoja!

ds:136:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]See Red, Mabel and I spitball project ideas every so often. We wanted to figure out something that could capitalize on the current trend in the forest!
ds:136:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Unaona Mwekundu, mimi na Mabel hujadili mawazo ya miradi mara moja moja. Tulitaka kupata jambo la kutuingizia faida kutokana na mtindo wa sasa msituni!

ds:136:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks to you, Critters have been sleeping around more these days!
ds:136:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kwa sababu yako, Wanyama wamekuwa wakilala na wenza mbalimbali mara nyingi zaidi siku hizi!

ds:136:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And what better way to make some extra coin, than offering a related service!
ds:136:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Na kuna njia bora gani ya kupata sarafu za ziada kuliko kutoa huduma inayohusiana na hilo!

ds:136:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We figure there’s bound to be some sexual avenues some critters have been wanting to explore, or are curious about, but were never able to.
ds:136:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tunadhani bila shaka kuna mambo fulani ya ngono ambayo wanyama fulani wamekuwa wakitaka kujaribu au wana udadisi nayo, lakini hawajawahi kupata nafasi.

ds:136:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Or kinks they didn’t even know existed!
ds:136:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Au mapendeleo ya ngono ambayo hata hawakujua yapo!

ds:136:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah Maverick didn’t know what sounding was until just a moment ago!
ds:136:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ndiyo, Maverick hakujua kuhusu kuingiza vitu kwenye mrija wa mkojo hadi muda mfupi uliopita!

ds:136:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I still don’t believe it! That can’t be a thing, no way!

ds:136:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s just say there are some advantages to being so small…
ds:136:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tuseme tu kwamba kuwa mdogo hivyo kuna faida zake…

ds:136:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]OK, Let’s move forward with the idea. We’ll need to come up with the logistics next… Are we charging folks for our consultation time?
ds:136:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]SAWA, tuendelee na wazo hilo. Tutahitaji kupanga jinsi ya kuliendesha baadaye… Tutawatoza watu kwa muda wa ushauri wetu?

ds:136:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Will there be “hands on” options for the service?

ds:136:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hmm good question… That would certainly make things a lot more fun…
ds:136:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hmm, swali zuri… Hakika hilo lingefanya mambo yawe ya kufurahisha zaidi…

ds:136:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That would feel weird to charge for…

ds:136:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maybe those options would be a bonus!
ds:136:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Labda huduma hizo zingekuwa zawadi ya ziada!

ds:136:197:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’ll let you guys get to it.

ds:136:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sounds good! We got plenty of kinks to iron out. Pun intended.
ds:136:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Vizuri! Tuna mafundo mengi ya kufungua katika kazi hii ya mapendeleo. Nimechezea maneno makusudi.

ds:136:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Take care Rascal! Maybe you can be a guinea pig for us once we get the ball rolling!
ds:136:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Uwe salama Rascal! Labda uwe mjaribiwa wetu tukianza!

ds:137:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Ah Rascal! Join us for a round!

ds:137:132:Dialogue Text.source:
You two seem chipper,
what’s the celebration?

ds:137:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Just a couple of blokes havin’ a cold one after a romp!
ds:137:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Wanaume wawili tu wakipata kinywaji baridi baada ya michezo ya ngono!

ds:137:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A quite surprising one, I might add!

ds:137:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, Rascal was actually there when Scarlett and I were planning it.
ds:137:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hehe, Rascal alikuwepo mimi na Scarlett tulipokuwa tukiipanga.

ds:137:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa bahati nzuri, mimi hupata nguvu tena haraka.

ds:137:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]How many rounds did we go, four?

ds:137:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah, I just did two. You guys did four…
ds:137:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah, mimi nilifanya mbili tu. Nyinyi mlifanya nne…

ds:137:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s back at the house cleaning up. She let us off the hook to get some beers!
ds:137:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Amerudi nyumbani kusafisha. Ameturuhusu tutoke tupate bia!

ds:137:162:Dialogue Text.source: I caught the tail end of it.

ds:137:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vizuri sana, unataka kusikia mambo yote ya kusisimua?

ds:137:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It all started just a bit ago.

ds:137:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Scarlett and I were testing out some of the gear you delivered us.
ds:137:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mimi na Scarlett tulikuwa tukijaribu baadhi ya vifaa ulivyotuletea.

ds:137:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… I don’t think that was quite her words…

ds:137:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It sounded more like we were going to PICK UP beers…
ds:137:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ilisikika zaidi kama tulipaswa KWENDA KUCHUKUA bia…

ds:137:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh hello Rascal! Excuse me while I lose my cool on these two boys.
ds:137:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oh, hujambo Rascal! Nisamehe ninapowafokea hawa jamaa wawili.

ds:137:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She strapped me to this apparatus, and put blinders on me.

ds:137:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See I like being at my wife’s mercy, so UH, I was already pretty excited.
ds:137:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unaona, napenda kuwa chini ya mamlaka ya mke wangu, kwa hiyo AAH, tayari nilikuwa nimesisimka sana.

ds:137:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She started preppin’ my rear with her tongue, right?
ds:137:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Akaanza kutayarisha makalio yangu kwa ulimi wake, sivyo?

ds:137:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Slippin’ a few fingers in here ’n there - getting me ready.
ds:137:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Akiingiza vidole vichache hapa na pale - akinitayarisha.

ds:137:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I’m expecting either a toy or somethin, right?
ds:137:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo ninatarajia labda kifaa cha ngono au kitu kama hicho, sivyo?

ds:137:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]What on EARTH ARE YOU DOING lounging about?!

ds:137:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh you thought you’d leave me to clean up that mess?
ds:137:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, ulidhani ungeniacha nisafishe uchafu wote ule?

ds:137:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]There’s cum on the walls Peter, you know what happens if we let that sit.
ds:137:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kuna bao kwenye kuta Peter, unajua kitakachotokea tukiliacha likae hapo.

ds:137:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y-yes, love. I’ll go help clean it up.

ds:137:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh no you don’t. You’re not off the hook either! Half of the mess is all you!
ds:137:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, hapana kabisa. Wewe pia hutaepuka! Nusu ya uchafu huo ni wako wewe!

ds:137:212:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahh… see, I would but… these old bones, y’know? I gotta rest!
ds:137:212:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ahh… unaona, ningesaidia lakini… hii mifupa mizee, unajua? Lazima nipumzike!

ds:137:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Nope. You clearly didn’t need a rest plowing my husband.
ds:137:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hapana. Ni wazi hukuhitaji kupumzika ulipokuwa ukimtomba mume wangu.

ds:137:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, I hope you have a lovely afternoon. [pic=7]Take care, now!
ds:137:216:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, natumaini utakuwa na alasiri nzuri. [pic=7]Uwe salama basi!

ds:138:201:Dialogue Text.source: Then all of a sudden, THIS GUY wraps his paws around my entire torso!
ds:138:201:Dialogue Text.target: Kisha ghafla, HUYU JAMAA anaizungushia mikono yake kiwiliwili changu chote!

ds:138:203:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, ok that’s a bit of an exaggeration…

ds:138:205:Dialogue Text.source: He starts hot-doggin’ me, gettin’ me prepped for what’s to come!
ds:138:205:Dialogue Text.target: Anaanza kusugua uume wake katikati ya matako yangu, akinitayarisha kwa kitakachofuata!

ds:138:207:Dialogue Text.source: Naw hah, I was just trying to get it in…
ds:138:207:Dialogue Text.target: La, hah, nilikuwa nikijaribu tu kuuingiza…

ds:138:209:Dialogue Text.source: He slides in, and BAM! Balls deep. Down to the hilt.
ds:138:209:Dialogue Text.target: Anaingiza, na BAM! Hadi kwenye korodani. Wote hadi mwisho.

ds:138:213:Dialogue Text.source: And he starts pumpin away! Gawd, am I feelin’ it!
ds:138:213:Dialogue Text.target: Na anaanza kusukuma! Jamani, ninahisi kweli!

ds:138:214:Dialogue Text.source: A good few minutes in, and I’m leakin’ pre-everywhere.
ds:138:214:Dialogue Text.target: Dakika chache nzuri zinapita, na maji yangu ya mwanzo yanavuja kila mahali.

ds:138:216:Dialogue Text.source: Scarlett starts servicing me from the front!

ds:138:217:Dialogue Text.source: Now I’ve got cuties on either side of me!
ds:138:217:Dialogue Text.target: Sasa nina warembo pande zote mbili!

ds:138:221:Dialogue Text.source: Now I won’t deny it, I can’t last very long in the sheets.
ds:138:221:Dialogue Text.target: Sasa sitakataa, mimi sidumu sana kitandani.

ds:138:222:Dialogue Text.target: Lakini nikiwa nimebanwa katikati namna hiyo?

ds:138:223:Dialogue Text.source: I don’t think I lasted a minute.

ds:139:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hello dear, we were just talking about you!

ds:139:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Of course! We were talking about how things have gotten a whole lot naughtier since you’ve been here.
ds:139:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bila shaka! Tulikuwa tukizungumza kuhusu jinsi mambo yamekuwa machafu kimapenzi zaidi tangu ulipokuja hapa.

ds:139:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! Since telling you about my little story, I decided to get some more girl time with Scarlett.
ds:139:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hakika! Tangu nikusimulie kisa changu kile, niliamua kutumia muda zaidi na Scarlett, sisi wanawake tu.

ds:139:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]All this talk makes me wanna go down on your cute bird rump, right here, right now.
ds:139:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mazungumzo haya yote yananifanya nitake kuyafurahisha kwa mdomo makalio yako mazuri ya ndege, papa hapa sasa hivi.

ds:139:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Scarlett! Gosh, not in front of Rascal!

ds:139:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! Let ‘em watch! Better yet, let him join!
ds:139:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah! Mwache atazame! Bora zaidi, mwache ajiunge!

ds:139:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I just thought of a good name for your… “side business.”
ds:139:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh! Nimepata jina zuri la ile… “biashara yako ya pembeni.”

ds:139:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Instead of Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom…
ds:139:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Badala ya Panda na Paa kwa Penny Unyoya…

ds:139:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kisa chenye mambo mengi ya kusisimua, eh?

ds:139:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know, we were also talking a bit about some stuff Penny wants to experiment with…
ds:139:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unajua, pia tulikuwa tukizungumza kidogo kuhusu mambo fulani Penny anayotaka kujaribu…

ds:139:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Come on darling, you can hide me under those feathers, and I can do my work right here~ No one will suspect a thing!
ds:139:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haya mpenzi, unaweza kunificha chini ya manyoya hayo, nami nifanye kazi yangu papa hapa~ Hakuna atakayeshuku kitu!

ds:139:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That is… If you can contain yourself…

ds:139:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Scarlett, do I need to drop you in the river AGAIN?

ds:139:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I do hope you can explore that side of you if it’s something you want, though!
ds:139:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini natumaini utaweza kujaribu upande huo wako ikiwa ndicho unachotaka!

ds:139:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And a complete mockery of my business! How dare you!
ds:139:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Na ni kuifanyia biashara yangu mzaha kabisa! Umethubutuje!

ds:139:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tena hakuna majina ya kufurahisha yanayoweza kwenda na Penny Unyoya!

ds:139:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Penny Plume’s Ride and Spoon? Penny Plume’s Ride and Poon?
ds:139:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Panda na Kumbatio kwa Penny Unyoya? Panda na Papuchi kwa Penny Unyoya?

ds:139:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hehe, so you know how our wonderful Penny here is quite the service girl, right? Married to her work and being so useful…
ds:139:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hehe, basi unajua Penny wetu mzuri anavyopenda kuhudumia, sivyo? Ameolewa na kazi yake na kupenda kuwa mwenye manufaa…

ds:139:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She was just telling me how exciting it would be to offer a different service!
ds:139:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alikuwa akiniambia jinsi ingesisimua kutoa huduma tofauti!

ds:139:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Aw, what, should I really not continue?

ds:139:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gosh, you’ll be the death of me, girl.

ds:139:211:Dialogue Text.source:
You don’t have to share
if you don’t want to.

ds:139:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well, I had a dream once, and for some reason I can’t get it out of my head…
ds:139:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naam, niliota ndoto siku moja, na kwa sababu fulani haiondoki akilini mwangu…

ds:139:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]I was tied up at my perch… Blind folded… gagged… My rear completely exposed…
ds:139:216:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Nilikuwa nimefungwa kwenye kituo changu cha kutua… Nimefunikwa macho… Nimezibwa mdomo… Makalio yangu yako wazi kabisa…

ds:139:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]One by one, critters would have a go, leaving me a quivering mess!
ds:139:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Mmoja baada ya mwingine, wanyama walikuwa wakinifanya, wakiniacha nikitetemeka kabisa!

ds:139:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ilikuwa… ya aibu? Ya kunichukulia kama kitu?

ds:139:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw I dunno… it probably sounds stupid…

ds:139:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sivyo?? Huko ndiko kupenda kutazamwa kimapenzi kwa kiwango cha juu!

ds:139:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus, I think it’s super cute since you’re such a service bird already! You truly just want to make your customers happy!
ds:139:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pia, nadhani inapendeza sana kwa kuwa tayari wewe ni ndege wa kuhudumia! Kwa kweli unataka tu kuwafurahisha wateja wako!

ds:139:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Honey, I’m all for it, I say we make it happen!
ds:139:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mpenzi, naunga mkono kabisa, nasema tuyafanye yatokee!

ds:13:19:Dialogue Text.source: Due to an unknown creature, the path to the north is closed.
ds:13:19:Dialogue Text.target: Kwa sababu ya kiumbe asiyejulikana, njia ya kaskazini imefungwa.

ds:13:21:Dialogue Text.source: You see a sign, but it's too dark to read…
ds:13:21:Dialogue Text.target: Unaona kibao, lakini kuna giza mno kusoma…

ds:140:133:Dialogue Text.target: *If the player has done Dustin’s Scene play this first.*

ds:140:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re asking that after plowing my rear?

ds:146:14:Dialogue Text.target: Mchanganyiko wa matunda na mboga. Ungependa kuvila?

ds:146:17:Dialogue Text.source: Delicious! Definitely fresh! You would eat this all day if you could!
ds:146:17:Dialogue Text.target: Ladha nzuri! Hakika ni vipya kabisa! Ungevila hivi siku nzima kama ungeweza!

ds:146:18:Dialogue Text.source: … Oh? There appears to be a package of chocolates!
ds:146:18:Dialogue Text.target: … Oh? Kunaonekana kuwa na kifurushi cha chokoleti!

ds:146:20:Dialogue Text.source: A pleasant assortment of wildflowers. It’s an awfully kind gesture for a stranger.
ds:146:20:Dialogue Text.target: Mchanganyiko mzuri wa maua ya porini. Ni ukarimu mkubwa sana kwa mgeni asiyejulikana.

ds:146:22:Dialogue Text.source: To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
ds:146:22:Dialogue Text.target: Kwa msafiri wetu aliyechoka~ Pona haraka! Tuna hamu ya kukutana nawe! Ukurasa unaofuata umejaa sahihi na alama za nyayo.

ds:147:270:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:147:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, these days, I just go with the flow.
ds:147:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hmm, siku hizi ninafuata tu mambo yanavyokwenda.

ds:147:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]When I was more active, I had a lot more lady partners.
ds:147:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nilipokuwa najishughulisha zaidi, nilikuwa na wenza wa kike wengi zaidi.

ds:147:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But then I’d go on a guy kick from time to time.
ds:147:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini mara kwa mara ningekuwa na kipindi cha kuvutiwa sana na wanaume.

ds:147:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I actually did a lot of group activities back then, probably why I’m so flexible.
ds:147:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa kweli nilifanya mambo mengi ya kikundi zamani, huenda ndiyo maana mimi ni mnyumbufu sana.

ds:148:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This is a little somethin’ you pick up on the track.
ds:148:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hili ni jambo dogo unalojifunza uwanjani pa mbio.

ds:148:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, critters have all sorts of unique shapes ‘n forms, yeah?
ds:148:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unaona, wanyama wana kila aina ya maumbo ya kipekee, sivyo?

ds:148:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We can be nimble and quick in our own way.
ds:148:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tunaweza kuwa wepesi na wenye kasi kwa njia zetu wenyewe.

ds:148:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Some of us can jump, some of us can run.
ds:148:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baadhi yetu wanaweza kuruka, wengine wanaweza kukimbia.

ds:148:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But you my friend, you look like you can ROLL.
ds:148:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lakini wewe rafiki yangu, unaonekana unaweza KUBINGIRIKA.

ds:148:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It might seem a bit funny, but we gotta work with what we got! It’s survival!
ds:148:205:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Inaweza kuonekana ya kuchekesha kidogo, lakini lazima tutumie tulicho nacho! Ni kunusurika!

ds:148:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let’s see it Red! Give us a couple good rolls!
ds:148:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tuonyeshe Mwekundu! Bingirika vizuri mara mbili tuone!

ds:148:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m a marathon athlete traveling and training!
ds:148:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mimi ni mwanariadha wa mbio za marathoni ninayesafiri na kufanya mazoezi!

ds:148:212:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You must be that “Red” fella I keep hearing about!
ds:148:212:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lazima wewe ndiye yule “Mwekundu” ninayeendelea kusikia habari zake!

ds:148:215:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Keep up that rolling and I’ll see ya for the next race!
ds:148:215:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Endelea kubingirika, nami nitakuona katika mbio zinazofuata!

ds:148:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s a good lad. First to the end of this grassy stretch wins!
ds:148:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vizuri kijana. Atakayefika kwanza mwisho wa eneo hili la nyasi ndiye mshindi!

ds:148:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna teach you somethin, and we can have another go next time, yeah?
ds:148:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nitakufundisha kitu, kisha tutajaribu tena wakati mwingine, sawa?

ds:148:227:Dialogue Text.source: Player prompted to Press button to roll. Roll 3 times (Lock camera? If Red moves too far, have the Squirrel call after him and return him or something.)
ds:148:227:Dialogue Text.target: Player prompted to Press button to roll. Roll 3 times (Lock camera? If Red moves too far, have the Squirrel call after him and return him or something.)

ds:148:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Ah, say mate. I may have broken a big racer rule.
ds:148:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Ah, rafiki. Huenda nimevunja kanuni kubwa ya wakimbiaji.

ds:148:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t race if you aren’t on a first-name basis!
ds:148:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Usishindane mbio ikiwa hamjajuana majina ya kwanza!

ds:148:232:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let’s see it Red! Give us a couple good rolls!
ds:148:232:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tuonyeshe Mwekundu! Bingirika vizuri mara mbili tuone!

ds:149:270:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:149:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh you know me, dear. I’m not picky at all.

ds:149:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll always have a soft spot for you boys, of course!

ds:149:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I can get down with anyone!

ds:150:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Katika uhusiano wa kimapenzi, wanawake tu kabisa!

ds:150:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perhaps I’m just super open minded, but I think it’s because I’ve been in the game for so long.
ds:150:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Labda nina fikra wazi sana, lakini nadhani ni kwa sababu nimekuwa katika michezo hii kwa muda mrefu.

ds:150:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can appreciate almost anything these days!

ds:150:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Scarlett has had a ton of fun pegging me in the past, and she’s been known to surprise me with some male partners from time to time!
ds:150:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Scarlett amefurahia sana kunitomba nyuma kwa kifaa cha ngono cha kufunga kwa mshipi zamani, na amekuwa akiniletea wenza wa kiume wa kushtukiza mara kwa mara!

ds:150:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I suppose I’m bi? Really anything Scarlett plans, I’m into.
ds:150:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nadhani napenda jinsia zote mbili? Kwa kweli, chochote Scarlett anachopanga, nakipenda.

ds:150:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Perhaps I’m just Scarlett-Sexual – That’s a thing, right?
ds:150:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Labda mimi ni wa mwelekeo wa Scarlett tu - huo upo, sivyo?

ds:150:270:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:151:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m good with whatever. So long as they can keep up.
ds:151:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mimi niko sawa na chochote. Mradi tu waweze kuendana nami.

ds:151:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I think I lean more towards female partners…
ds:151:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini nadhani napendelea zaidi wenza wa kike…

ds:151:269:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:152:168:Dialogue Text.source: BEAVER LORE UNLOCKED - Dildos made out of wood?
ds:152:168:Dialogue Text.target: BEAVER LORE UNLOCKED - Dildos made out of wood?

ds:152:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
ds:152:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ina mikunjo yote inayofaa, na unene wa kutosha kukujaza kwelikweli!

ds:152:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So what’s the deal, you give him a toy and he’ll fetch the wood?
ds:152:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basi makubaliano ni nini, unampa kifaa cha ngono naye atakuletea mbao?

ds:152:182:Dialogue Text.source: No, I’m trading the toy for a pair of floaties!
ds:152:182:Dialogue Text.target: Hapana, nabadilishana kifaa cha ngono na jozi ya vifaa vya kuelea!

ds:152:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, Red, I feel bad for making you go through all this for me.
ds:152:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah Mwekundu, naona vibaya kukufanya upitie yote haya kwa ajili yangu.

ds:152:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t tell you how much I appreciate it!

ds:152:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure those floaties will come in handy, but I feel I asked a lot of you.
ds:152:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nina hakika vifaa hivyo vya kuelea vitafaa, lakini nahisi nimekuomba mengi.

ds:152:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to make it up to you somehow!
ds:152:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nitahakikisha nakulipa wema huu kwa namna fulani!

ds:153:18:Dialogue Text.target: Alama ya maandishi ya ajabu gani hii!

ds:153:19:Dialogue Text.source: One could only guess what it might mean.
ds:153:19:Dialogue Text.target: Mtu anaweza kubashiri tu maana yake.

ds:154:18:Dialogue Text.source: A monument of some sort, covered by mysterious inscriptions and strange glyphs.
ds:154:18:Dialogue Text.target: Mnara wa aina fulani, uliofunikwa kwa maandishi ya mafumbo na alama za maandishi za ajabu.

ds:154:19:Dialogue Text.source: One can only guess what it might mean.
ds:154:19:Dialogue Text.target: Mtu anaweza kubashiri tu maana yake.

ds:155:18:Dialogue Text.target: Rundo kubwa la vumbi la mbao.

ds:156:18:Dialogue Text.source: A broom to keep the workshop neat and tidy.
ds:156:18:Dialogue Text.target: Ufagio wa kuweka karakana safi na yenye mpangilio.

ds:157:18:Dialogue Text.source: Paint, to give wooden carvings a splash of color.
ds:157:18:Dialogue Text.target: Rangi za kuzipa nakshi za mbao mguso wa rangi.

ds:158:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hmmmm, sijui kuna nini hapa chini?

ds:159:18:Dialogue Text.source: A nice big stack of building materials.
ds:159:18:Dialogue Text.target: Rundo zuri kubwa la vifaa vya ujenzi.

ds:15:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Come back… next game update or something…
ds:15:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Rudi… katika sasisho linalofuata la mchezo au kitu kama hicho…

ds:160:18:Dialogue Text.source: This workbench has surely seen a lot of use!
ds:160:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hakika meza hii ya kazi imetumiwa sana!

ds:161:18:Dialogue Text.source: A sturdy wooden masterpiece in the making!
ds:161:18:Dialogue Text.target: Kazi bora imara ya mbao inayoendelea kutengenezwa!

ds:162:270:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:162:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, I’m more of a lady’s man.

ds:162:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ve been known to fool around from time to time…
ds:162:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini nimewahi kuchezeana kimapenzi mara kwa mara pia…

ds:162:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Why Red, you wanna get it on?

ds:162:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mwekundu! Rafiki! Huu ni muda wa kazi!

ds:162:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can’t fraternize with the clients during business hours, that’s very unprofessional.
ds:162:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Siwezi kuchezeana na wateja wakati wa kazi, hiyo si ya kitaalamu kabisa.

ds:162:277:Dialogue Text.target: Si sisi ni kama wafanyakazi wenza?

ds:162:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What kind of boss would I be!

ds:162:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But in all seriousness, we’ll have to fool around sometime. I can introduce you to some friends later.
ds:162:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini nikisema kweli, itabidi tuchezeane siku moja. Naweza kukutambulisha kwa marafiki fulani baadaye.

ds:163:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ooh! Rascal, unaenda moja kwa moja kwenye jambo!

ds:163:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m definitely into guys! Especially the larger ones!
ds:163:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hakika napenda wanaume! Hasa wenye miili mikubwa zaidi!

ds:163:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can appreciate a lady’s touch for sure.
ds:163:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bila shaka, naweza kufurahia mguso wa mwanamke.

ds:163:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s something about a guy that you can’t quite replace!
ds:163:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini kuna kitu kuhusu mwanaume ambacho hakuna kingine kinachoweza kuchukua nafasi yake kikamilifu!

ds:163:270:Dialogue Text.target: Mwelekeo wako wa kingono ni upi?

ds:164:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The sweetest lil’ guy anyone could ask for!
ds:164:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mwanaume mdogo mtamu zaidi ambaye mtu angeweza kumtamani!

ds:164:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]He’s a fancy folk from far away - but he couldn’t resist my classic country charm!
ds:164:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ni mtu wa fahari kutoka mbali - lakini hakuweza kuupinga mvuto wangu wa kawaida wa kijijini!

ds:164:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1](Miaka ishirini na saba, lakini nani anahesabu)

ds:164:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And have been happily together ever since!
ds:164:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na tumekuwa pamoja kwa furaha tangu hapo!

ds:164:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Anafanya kazi kama mkusanyaji na mpelelezi wa mji!

ds:164:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He basically scrounges up whatever odds and ends that he can find.
ds:164:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa kifupi hukusanya vitu vidogo vya kila aina anavyoweza kupata.

ds:164:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maverick gathers stuff that floats from the river, and my husband gathers stuff on land.
ds:164:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maverick hukusanya vitu vinavyoelea mtoni, na mume wangu hukusanya vitu vya nchi kavu.

ds:164:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’ll be away for days at a time though…
ds:164:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini huwa anaondoka kwa siku kadhaa kwa wakati mmoja…

ds:164:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though, he should be coming back soon!

ds:165:145:Dialogue Text.source: I noticed there’s a crib in your house?
ds:165:145:Dialogue Text.target: Nimeona kuna kitanda cha mtoto nyumbani kwako?

ds:165:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yes, it’s hard to get rid of something so precious!
ds:165:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ndiyo, ni vigumu kuondoa kitu chenye thamani kubwa hivyo!

ds:165:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I wouldn’t imagine you’ve had critters of your own?

ds:165:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha, yes I figured a youngin’ like yourself wouldn’t be strapped down yet.
ds:165:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, ndiyo, nilidhani kijana kama wewe bado huna majukumu ya aina hiyo.

ds:165:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve had a few litters over the years, but I don’t plan on having any more.
ds:165:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nimezaa makundi kadhaa ya watoto kwa miaka iliyopita, lakini sipangi kupata wengine.

ds:165:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gettin’ pretty old these days, haha…

ds:165:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I just mother all the critters here!
ds:165:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo nawalea tu wanyama wote wa hapa kama mama!

ds:166:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hiyo ndiyo sehemu yangu ndogo ya nyumbani!

ds:166:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I grew up on a farm, so some of the old habits die hard.
ds:166:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona, nilikulia shambani, kwa hiyo tabia fulani za zamani ni vigumu kuziacha.

ds:166:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus, once you’ve lived on fresh produce, you can’t go back!
ds:166:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pia, ukishazoea kula mazao mapya, huwezi kurudia ulivyokuwa ukila zamani!

ds:167:161:Dialogue Text.target: Unajua porojo zenye mambo ya kusisimua?

ds:167:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And so many critters talk to me about everything, so I’m VERY in the know!
ds:167:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na wanyama wengi sana huzungumza nami kuhusu kila kitu, kwa hiyo najua MENGI SANA!

ds:167:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Word gets around here quickly, and I’m probably mostly to blame…
ds:167:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Habari huenea haraka hapa, na pengine mimi ndiye wa kulaumiwa zaidi…

ds:167:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I probably have too much time on my hands…
ds:167:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Labda nina muda mwingi sana usio na kazi…

ds:167:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Fortunately, this makes me a great resource!
ds:167:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa bahati nzuri, hilo linanifanya niwe chanzo kizuri cha habari!

ds:167:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]If ya need help or information on anything, I can probably help!
ds:167:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ukihitaji msaada au taarifa kuhusu chochote, huenda nikaweza kusaidia!

ds:168:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We don’t really have a ‘leader’ or anything.
ds:168:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa kweli hatuna ‘kiongozi’ wala kitu kama hicho.

ds:168:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I tend to take on a majority of the responsibilities or mishaps.
ds:168:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini huwa nachukua majukumu mengi zaidi au kushughulikia matatizo.

ds:168:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Like organizing events, or if our town is having problems, or whatever.
ds:168:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kama kupanga matukio, au mji wetu unapokuwa na matatizo, au chochote.

ds:168:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Like when the critters found you! They brought you to me!

ds:168:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some say I’m good at organizin’ ‘n seeing the big picture…
ds:168:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Wengine wanasema mimi ni hodari wa kupanga na kuyaona mambo kwa upana…

ds:168:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I just like to think I’m taking care of my family!
ds:168:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini napenda tu kufikiri kwamba ninaitunza familia yangu!

ds:169:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]He and I have been neighbors forever. He’s so helpful and handy!
ds:169:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mimi na yeye tumekuwa majirani tangu zamani sana. Ni mwenye kusaidia na fundi hodari!

ds:169:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve had him over many times to fix up the house! He’s always happy to be of service.
ds:169:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nimemwalika nyumbani mara nyingi kufanya matengenezo! Daima anafurahi kuhudumia.

ds:169:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Despite him favoring the male critters, he used to swing with my husband and I back in the day!
ds:169:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ingawa anapendelea wanyama wa kiume, zamani alikuwa akibadilishana wenza na mimi na mume wangu!
