ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Like half of the glyphs are about how they switch sides, fill her holes, bathe her in their… *ahem* well, you know…
ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Karibu nusu ya alama za maandishi zinahusu jinsi wanavyobadilishana pande, kujaza matundu yake, kumuogesha kwa… *anakohoa* basi, unajua…

ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I can’t imagine what sort of worship this was…
ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kusema kweli, siwezi kuwaza ilikuwa ibada ya aina gani…

ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.source: Are you sure this was a form of worship?
ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.target: Una uhakika hii ilikuwa aina ya ibada?

ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well certainly! These inscriptions are rare, you see. Especially for their time.
ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bila shaka! Maandishi haya yaliyochongwa ni nadra, unaona. Hasa kwa wakati wao.

ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Writing and record-keeping was a niche task. Only certain learned critters were scribes. So typically, only important events were written down.
ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kuandika na kutunza kumbukumbu ilikuwa kazi ya watu wachache. Wanyama fulani tu wenye elimu walikuwa waandishi. Kwa hiyo kwa kawaida, matukio muhimu tu ndiyo yaliyoandikwa.

ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Still, quite a saucy ritual… I can’t quite connect the dots…
ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hata hivyo, tambiko la utundu kweli… Siwezi kabisa kuunganisha mambo…

ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… But this Forest was indeed full of “love” before.
ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… Lakini hakika Msitu huu ulikuwa umejaa “mapenzi” zamani.

ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.source: What else do you know about the “Shrine Maiden”?
ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.target: Unajua nini kingine kuhusu huyu “Binti wa Mahali Patakatifu”?

ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.source: They shared Lanora, body and soul.
ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.target: Walishirikiana kuwa na Lanora, mwili na roho.

ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.source: One would take her from the front, and the other would take her from the back.
ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.target: Mmoja alimwingilia kwa mbele, na mwingine alimwingilia kwa nyuma.

ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.source: Long into the night, the disciples would spend hours trying to sate Lanora.
ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.target: Usiku ulipozidi, wafuasi walitumia saa nyingi wakijaribu kumridhisha Lanora.

ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.source: It’s said her lust and scent invigorated the males. Tapping into their primal natures…
ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.target: Inasemekana tamaa na harufu yake ziliwapa wanaume nguvu. Zikichochea silika zao za asili…

ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.source: I just finished fooling around with some friends, right?
ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.target: Nilikuwa nimetoka tu kuchezeana na marafiki fulani, sawa?

ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.source: We were cuddling together, catching our breath and enjoying the shade, y’know?
ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.target: Tulikuwa tumekumbatiana, tunapumua baada ya shughuli na kufurahia kivuli, unajua?

ds:296:144:Dialogue Text.source: Well across from me, I spot her…

ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a bit shorter than you, super cute hat, rockin’ bod…
ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.target: Ni mfupi kidogo kuliko wewe, kofia nzuri sana, mwili wa kuvutia…

ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.source: She was ridin’ this guy, giving me quite the show!
ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.target: Alikuwa akimpanda jamaa huyu, akinipa tamasha la kuvutia kweli!

ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.source: I thought it was just a coincidence, and then we locked eyes.
ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.target: Nilidhani ni sadfa tu, halafu macho yetu yakakutana.

ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.source: She lifted her tail to give me the full show! I was hard again in seconds!
ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.target: Akainua mkia wake kunipa tamasha zima! Nikasimama tena baada ya sekunde chache!

ds:297:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A partner? Naw, this is a pretty solo venture.
ds:297:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mshirika? Hapana, hii ni biashara ya peke yangu kabisa.

ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why do you ask Red, you want in as a business partner?
ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kwa nini unauliza, Mwekundu, unataka kuingia kama mshirika wa biashara?

ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I might be able to cut you in… but we wouldn’t be look at anything more than 7 percent…
ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huenda nikaweza kukupa sehemu… lakini hatungezungumzia chochote kinachozidi asilimia 7…

ds:297:139:Dialogue Text.source:
No, I meant a
relationship partner.

ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Naw, I don’t really have time for that sorta thing…
ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hapana, sina muda hasa wa mambo ya namna hiyo…

ds:297:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]She was absolutely inviting me to join… but uh…

ds:297:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]For some reason… I couldn’t accept it…

ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I dunno Red… There was something different about her…
ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sijui, Mwekundu… Kulikuwa na kitu tofauti kwake…

ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just got kinda scared that… maybe that was a path I wasn’t ready for…
ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Niliogopa kidogo kwamba… labda hiyo ilikuwa njia ambayo sikuwa tayari kuifuata…

ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I just don’t have time for something serious, y’know?
ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Basi sina muda tu wa uhusiano wa dhati, unajua?

ds:297:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a lot of work running a business.

ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So it’s hard to imagine squeezing in a relationship…
ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kwa hiyo ni vigumu kuwaza kupata nafasi ya uhusiano…

ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But, that’s not to say I don’t sleep around!
ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini, sisemi kwamba sifanyi ngono na watu mbalimbali!

ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, there’s a nice lil lagoon down the river.
ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Heh, kuna ziwa dogo zuri ukishuka mto.

ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.source:
Well maybe she didn’t want
anything serious.
ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.target:
Basi labda hakutaka
uhusiano wowote wa dhati.

ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.source:
You should!
She seems interested, and
it might be a fun opportunity.
ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.target:
Unapaswa kuzungumza naye!
Anaonekana amevutiwa, na
huenda ikawa nafasi ya kufurahi.

ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a common place to go for a quick hook up!
ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ni mahali pa kawaida pa kwenda kupata mwenzi wa ngono ya haraka!

ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red, I ain’t gonna sugar coat it, it’s basically a non-stop orgy.
ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mwekundu, sitakupamba maneno, kimsingi ni ngono ya kikundi isiyoisha.

ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yep! I used to spend a lot of time there! Buncha party animals!
ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ndiyo! Nilikuwa nikitumia muda mwingi huko! Wanyama wengi wapenda starehe!

ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Not quite my speed these days… but I meet up with some old friends and fool around here ’n there.
ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Siku hizi si mwendo wangu hasa… lakini hukutana na marafiki wa zamani na kuchezeana hapa na pale.

ds:297:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should really take ya down there sometime!

ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know… There is this one girl at the lagoon…
ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unajua… Kuna msichana mmoja pale kwenye ziwa dogo…

ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm! Y’know after hearing it aloud, it seems so obvious.
ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm! Unajua, nikisikia nikisema kwa sauti, inaonekana wazi sana.

ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I could always let her know what I’m looking for, I’m sure she’d understand!
ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Daima naweza kumweleza ninachotafuta, nina hakika ataelewa!

ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Part of me thinks I actually WANT to be serious with her…
ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kwa upande mmoja, nafikiri kwa kweli NATAKA uhusiano wa dhati naye…

ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m serious Red! This is kinda why I was avoiding it… I don’t wanna mess it up…
ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ninasema kweli, Mwekundu! Hiyo ndiyo sababu kidogo nilikuwa nikilikwepa… Sitaki kuliharibu…

ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.source:
Mmm, I think you should talk to her.
You wouldn’t want to miss
this experience entirely, right?
ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.target:
Mmm, nadhani unapaswa kuzungumza naye.
Usingetaka kukosa kabisa
uzoefu huu, sivyo?

ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some flirty smiles and gestures here ’n there, but the last time I saw her…
ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tabasamu na ishara za kutongoza hapa na pale, lakini mara ya mwisho nilipomwona…

ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m usually pretty surface level when fooling with the critters there.
ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kwa kawaida, ninapochezeana na wanyama huko, sijihusishi kwa undani sana.

ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think you’re right, Red! I’ll talk to her!

ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.source:
And thank you
for the saucy story!
ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.target:
Nawe asante
kwa hadithi ya utundu!

ds:297:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a lil’ spicy though, so be prepared!
ds:297:198:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ingawa ina utundu kidogo, kwa hiyo jiandae!

ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah I’ll say! Ya practically jumped on me!

ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.source: Gus’ might be a gentle giant, but ohgosh, when all that weight is on top of you…
ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.target: Huenda Gus ni jitu mpole, lakini jamani, uzito wote ule unapokuwa juu yako…

ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.source: H-hey… I know I’ve put on a few pounds…

ds:298:293:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I didn’t mean it that way!

ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.source: You’re just a lot bigger than me, and uh, heh… It’s super hot.
ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.target: Wewe ni mkubwa zaidi kuliko mimi tu, na ee, heh… Inasisimua sana.

ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh I see. Well, I’m glad you enjoyed it!

ds:303:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m not gonna lie - that haiku was a lot lamer until you explained it.

ds:303:357:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, it may be a bit of a stretch, but that’s what I was thinking when writing.

ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? This idea really echos with the idea of time as a whole.
ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Si ndiyo? Wazo hili linaendana sana na dhana ya wakati kwa ujumla.

ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Though we see time as a day to day thing, thousands of years ago, or thousands of years from now - so many things change, yet so much remains the same.
ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ingawa tunauona wakati kama jambo la kila siku, maelfu ya miaka iliyopita, au maelfu ya miaka ijayo - mambo mengi hubadilika, lakini mengi sana hubaki vilevile.

ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]A journey without an end - yet time marches on, and flows like a river.
ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Safari isiyo na mwisho - lakini wakati unaendelea mbele, ukitiririka kama mto.

ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s interesting to consider though, if "time" is the "river," then we are the "water."
ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hata hivyo, inavutia kuwaza kwamba ikiwa "wakati" ndio "mto," basi sisi ndio "maji."

ds:303:366:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And does the "water" come back in the form of "rain" and "snow"?

ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s not my greatest one. But I’ve captured a few concepts in this.
ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Si shairi langu bora kuliko yote. Lakini nimeweka dhana kadhaa ndani yake.

ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See Rascal, a difficult part of traditional haiku is the split of two ideas.
ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unaona Rascal, jambo gumu katika haiku ya jadi ni kutenganisha mawazo mawili.

ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Two ideas that contrast each other, they vibrate against each other and change the context of each other.
ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mawazo mawili yanayokinzana, yanayogongana, na kila moja hubadili muktadha wa jingine.

ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The poem is meant to capture both, the phenomena of an instant of observing water, yet the realization that every droplet of water is new.
ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Shairi linakusudia kuonyesha yote mawili: tukio la kutazama maji kwa muda mfupi, na kutambua kwamba kila tone la maji ni jipya.

ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each droplet that passes this place came from a glacier up above, and who knows, maybe it has made its way back here before.
ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kila tone linalopita hapa limetoka kwenye mto wa barafu kule juu, na nani ajuaye, labda liliwahi kurudi hapa kabla.

ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh damn, that’s crazy. I’ve never considered the water flowing down this river is unique…
ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dah, hiyo inashangaza. Sikuwahi kufikiria kwamba maji yanayotiririka kwenye mto huu ni ya kipekee…

ds:321:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kazi nzuri Rascal! Asante kwa msaada wako wote!

ds:321:131:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!

ds:321:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh hey, I’ve got a bell for you!

ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one’s for the perch across the river!
ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hii ni ya kituo cha kutua ng'ambo ya mto!

ds:321:210:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!

ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nice work Rascal! Thanks for all your help!
ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kazi nzuri Rascal! Asante kwa msaada wako wote!

ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Asante tena kwa kusaidia, Rascal, tunashukuru sana!

ds:322:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oooh, this’ll actually be a great opportunity for you!
ds:322:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oooh, hii kwa kweli itakuwa nafasi nzuri kwako!

ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s so many other critters to meet, so be sure to head down there tomorrow!
ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kuna wanyama wengine wengi sana wa kukutana nao, kwa hiyo hakikisha unaenda huko kesho!

ds:322:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh, Penny said she has something for ya!

ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Asante tena kwa kusaidia, Rascal, tunashukuru sana!

ds:322:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t forget, Penny said she has something for ya!

ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now I can show you my shop! I’ll give you the tour tomorrow!
ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sasa naweza kukuonyesha duka langu! Nitakutembeza kesho!

ds:326:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Also - be sure to stay off the bridge for now!

ds:326:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone! I think that about does it!

ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah, it’s nice to see a days hardwork pay off!
ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aa, inapendeza kuona kazi ngumu ya siku ikizaa matunda!

ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I wanna thank everyone for their help!
ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nataka kumshukuru kila mtu kwa msaada wake!

ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And a special thanks to our guest, Rascal!
ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Na shukrani maalumu kwa mgeni wetu, Rascal!

ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aye! Remind me to get you a drink at my shop later!
ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ndiyo! Nikumbushe nikupatie kinywaji dukani kwangu baadaye!

ds:326:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah, alright. First rounds on the house!
ds:326:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Aa, sawa. Raundi ya kwanza ni bure!

ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone, let’s all get a good nights rest!
ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sawa nyote, twende tukapate usingizi mzuri usiku!

ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! And don’t use the bridge just yet! We need to let it sit while the compounds dry.
ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! Na bado msitumie daraja! Tunahitaji kuliacha litulie wakati michanganyiko inakauka.

ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I let ya sleep in, but the day’s well on its way!
ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nimekuacha ulale zaidi, lakini siku imeenda sana!

ds:327:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Go check out the rest of the forest to the South!
ds:327:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nenda ukaangalie sehemu iliyobaki ya msitu Kusini!

ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.source: I don't think this is the way to go right now…
ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.target: Sidhani kwamba hii ndiyo njia ya kwenda kwa sasa…

ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3] Let me know if you're tired, you can stay the night!
ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3] Nijulishe kama umechoka, unaweza kulala hapa usiku!

ds:32:21:Dialogue Text.target: Kituo cha kutua kisicho na Penny.

ds:32:22:Dialogue Text.target: Kituo cha usafiri cha Penny kutua.

ds:32:23:Dialogue Text.source: No Penny to be seen though.

ds:330:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Please stay off the bridge for now!

ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.source: Evening ladies! What are you two up to?
ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.target: Habari za jioni wanawake! Ninyi wawili mnafanya nini?

ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and I were just talking about setting up a date with the plant-
ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mimi na Penny tulikuwa tukizungumzia kupanga miadi na mmea-

ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]OH MY GOSH, I JUST REMEMBERED! Rascal recently had his own experience with the plant!
ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]OO JAMANI, NIMEKUMBUKA SASA HIVI! Rascal alipata uzoefu wake mwenyewe na mmea hivi karibuni!

ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh? You’ve met our little friend in the woods?
ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo? Umekutana na rafiki yetu mdogo msituni?

ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.source: I did! It got well acquainted with my rear…
ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.target: Nimekutana naye! Aliyafahamu makalio yangu vizuri kabisa…

ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Tell me, are you comfortable being on the receiving end?

ds:331:584:Dialogue Text.source: I am! I quite enjoy it!

ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not a big fan, but I’m flexible.

ds:331:588:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to keep that in mind!

ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I actually ran into Rascal JUST AFTER it all went down.
ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo, kwa kweli nilikutana na Rascal MARA TU BAADA YA yote kutokea.

ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was gathering up my nerve to ask him out on a date - I didn’t even realize what he was up to.
ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nilikuwa najikusanyia ujasiri wa kumwalika kwenye miadi ya kimapenzi - hata sikutambua alichokuwa akifanya.

ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Turns out he was running an errand for Scarlett. Gathering some "fresh fertilizer," stored in Scarlett’s favorite way.
ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kumbe alikuwa akishughulikia agizo la Scarlett. Akikusanya “mbolea mpya”, iliyohifadhiwa kwa njia anayopenda Scarlett.

ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw, I see. But still, experiencing it at all is something to respect!
ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baa, naona. Lakini hata hivyo, kujaribu tu ni jambo la kuheshimu!

ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So he’s over there, clenching his butt cheeks, red in the face, cum oozing down his legs - I’m over there like ’Hey uhhh wanna get a drink maybe?’
ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa hiyo yuko pale, amebana matako, uso mwekundu, bao zinachuruzika miguuni - mimi niko pale kama ‘Hebu eee, labda unataka kwenda kunywa kitu?’

ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal’s so humble, he didn’t cut me off, or interrupt me. Just kindly held it in, squirming.
ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rascal ni mnyenyekevu sana, hakunikatiza, wala kuniingilia. Alizizuia tu kwa wema, akijipinda kwa shida.

ds:331:607:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well now you GOTTA take him on a date. You made him suffer!
ds:331:607:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Basi sasa LAZIMA umpeleke kwenye miadi. Ulimtesa!

ds:331:609:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It was so funny though! If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t change a thing.
ds:331:609:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini ilichekesha sana! Ningeweza kurudi nyuma kwa wakati, singebadilisha chochote.

ds:331:612:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m sorry. I’ll make it up on our date. Drinks on me!
ds:331:612:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Samahani. Nitakufidia kwenye miadi yetu. Vinywaji ni juu yangu!

ds:331:613:Dialogue Text.source: OK, I’ll hold you to it!

ds:331:615:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Great! I’ll move some things around and get back to you!
ds:331:615:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Vizuri! Nitapanga upya baadhi ya mambo halafu nikutafute!

ds:331:616:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Till then, Penny and I were making plans to visit our little plant friend…
ds:331:616:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hadi wakati huo, mimi na Penny tulikuwa tukipanga kumtembelea rafiki yetu mdogo mmea…

ds:331:618:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mabel, hearing you call anything "little" is bizarre…
ds:331:618:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mabel, kusikia ukiita chochote “kidogo” ni jambo la ajabu…

ds:331:620:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I got it from you! You’re always calling it "your little plant friend!"
ds:331:620:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nimeiga kutoka kwako! Daima unauita “rafiki yako mdogo mmea!”

ds:331:621:Dialogue Text.source: Do you see the plant often, Penny?

ds:331:624:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been taking Mabel with me on occasion these days.
ds:331:624:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siku hizi nimekuwa nikimchukua Mabel nami mara mojamoja.

ds:331:633:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That plant really knows how to treat a lady!

ds:331:636:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true! I think just about every critter has spent ample time with that plant…
ds:331:636:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ni kweli! Nadhani karibu kila mnyama ametumia muda wa kutosha na mmea ule…

ds:331:638:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]I’ve seen Scarlett and Peter there many times. I know Oliver has expressed interest. Bucky’s fooled around a few times.
ds:331:638:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Nimewaona Scarlett na Peter huko mara nyingi. Najua Oliver ameonyesha nia. Bucky amechezeana na mmea mara kadhaa.

ds:331:640:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I think I’ve literally seen every critter with that plant…
ds:331:640:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nadhani nimeona kihalisi kila mnyama akiwa na mmea ule…

ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]*cough* I may have uh… been in the area… Unnoticed… many times…
ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]*anakohoa* Huenda ee… nilikuwa karibu… Bila kuonekana… mara nyingi…

ds:331:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wha! Are you peeping on critters?

ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hey! I’m small! I can’t help if the other critters don’t notice me!
ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hebu! Mimi ni mdogo! Siwezi kuzuia wanyama wengine wasiponiona!

ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Especially in their intense throes of passion…
ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hasa wanapolemewa na misisimko mikali ya mapenzi…

ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So what are you two gonna do on your date?
ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kwa hiyo ninyi wawili mtafanya nini kwenye miadi yenu?

ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t wait to stuff my mouth! I’ll be full all night!
ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siwezi kusubiri kujaza mdomo wangu! Nitakuwa nimeshiba usiku mzima!

ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.source: Indeed! Can’t wait to "eat out" for our picnic!
ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.target: Hakika! Siwezi kusubiri “kula nje” kwenye pikiniki yetu!

ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t be fooled Rascal! Mabel isn’t as sweet and innocent as she looks!
ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Usidanganyike, Rascal! Mabel si mtamu na asiye na hatia kama anavyoonekana!

ds:331:661:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She’s been known to peep about on occasions!

ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.source:
Mabel, I hereby give you permission to peep
on any and all sexual activities I’m involved in.
ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.target:
Mabel, kwa kauli hii nakupa ruhusa ya kuchungulia
shughuli zozote za ngono ninazoshiriki, bila ubaguzi.

ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You must, however, regale all events to Penny Plume. No details shall be left out!
ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hata hivyo, lazima umsimulie Penny Unyoya matukio yote. Hakuna undani utakaorukwa!

ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.source: She was all tied up, gaping after this crazy messy pull out!
ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.target: Alikuwa amefungwa kote, tundu likiwa wazi baada ya kutolewa kule kulikoacha fujo za ajabu!

ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.source: I was right on her, so I could feel her twitching and squirming as she came.
ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.target: Nilikuwa juu yake kabisa, kwa hiyo niliweza kuhisi akitikisika na kujipinda alipofika kileleni.

ds:332:637:Dialogue Text.source: I’m tellin’ ya! I was being tickled!

ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.source: The plant was all slurping on my talons, you’d be giggling too!
ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.target: Mmea ulikuwa ukifyonza makucha yangu, nawe ungecheka!

ds:332:640:Dialogue Text.source: That’s not how I remember it!

ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.source: What about you? I seem to remember some intense shivers of pleasure when those tentacles were twisting around in ya.
ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.target: Na wewe je? Nakumbuka mitetemo mikali ya raha mikono ile ya mmea ilipokuwa ikijipinda ndani yako.

ds:332:644:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, bila shaka. Nilifika kileleni kwa nguvu.

ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm yeaah. I think this place will do just fine!
ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmmm, ndiiiyoo. Nadhani mahali hapa patafaa kabisa!

ds:333:31:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy mate! Just preparing for the dig!

ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I needed a bit more space, so I got the OK from Scarlett to do it here!
ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nilihitaji nafasi zaidi kidogo, kwa hiyo nikapata ruhusa ya Scarlett kufanya hapa!

ds:333:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll see, check up on me later!

ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just got some finishing touches, and we’ll be good to go!
ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nimebaki na marekebisho ya mwisho tu, halafu tutakuwa tayari!

ds:334:30:Dialogue Text.target: Hii kweli ni kazi ya kuvutia!

ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Siwezi kusubiri kukuonyesha nilichoandaa kwa ajili ya hiki!

ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Siwezi kusubiri kukuonyesha nilichoandaa kwa ajili ya hiki!

ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks mate! Just wait till we get to training!

ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ehhh, nitahitaji muda wa kupata nguvu tena. Hiyo ilikuwa kazi nyingi sana.

ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ehhh, nitahitaji muda wa kupata nguvu tena. Hiyo ilikuwa kazi nyingi sana.

ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! Dang Rascal, I couldn’t touch you!

ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.source: I suppose I learn from the best!
ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.target: Nadhani najifunza kutoka kwa bingwa mwenyewe!

ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re gonna be great at this! I’ll let you know when I get better routines set up!
ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hah! Utakuwa hodari sana wa hili! Nitakujulisha nikishaandaa ratiba bora zaidi za mazoezi!

ds:336:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hehehe… I’ve got a lot of fun stuff planned…

ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]True, but I usually hit folks a lot more than that!
ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kweli, lakini kwa kawaida huwapiga watu mara nyingi zaidi kuliko hiyo!

ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, I got ya a few times eh?

ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you could do better next time?
ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Unafikiri unaweza kufanya vizuri zaidi wakati mwingine?

ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal, mate, I’ll be honest. That was pathetic!
ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Rascal, rafiki, nitasema ukweli. Hiyo ilikuwa ya kusikitisha!

ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, you can only go up from here, right?
ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini hebu, kutoka hapa unaweza kuboreka tu, sivyo?

ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s give it another shot when you’re ready.

ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve got a fun lil’ routine set up.
ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nimeandaa ratiba ndogo ya mazoezi ya kufurahisha.

ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect, so you should be familiar with how to move your body pretty well, yeah?
ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vizuri kabisa, kwa hiyo unapaswa kujua vizuri kiasi jinsi ya kuusogeza mwili wako, eh?

ds:336:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oy! Ya ready to give this a shot?

ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! For now I’ve prepared this Practice Routine. Let’s get started!
ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vizuri! Kwa sasa nimeandaa Ratiba hii ya Kujifunzia. Tuanze!

ds:336:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna try to PELT YOU with ACORNS!

ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For this first round, we’ll just see how you fare for 30 seconds!
ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa raundi hii ya kwanza, tutaona tu unavyofanya kwa sekunde 30!

ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.source: Uhhh, I don’t like the sound of this…

ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Psssh, don’t worry mate, it’ll be fine!

ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know when you’re ready to get started!

ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I see, well, we just got this order in, so we’ll probably sit this one out.
ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Naona, basi, tumepokea agizo hili sasa hivi, kwa hiyo huenda tusishiriki hili.

ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s no rush!
You guys can join us.

ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s okay Rascal, we can’t exactly all ride Penny anyways. We’ll head over once we’re finished here.
ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ni sawa Rascal, hata hivyo hatuwezi sote kumpanda Penny. Tutakuja tukimaliza hapa.

ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Yep. Besides… that place kind of gives me the creeps…
ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Ndiyo. Isitoshe… mahali pale pananitia hofu kidogo…

ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, we’ll be sure to catch you two up then!

ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Come quick! There’s something going on at the ruins!

ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Whoa, what do you mean? Is something wrong?

ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Augustus just told me to round up all the critters! He seemed very excited.
ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Augustus ameniambia tu niwakusanye wanyama wote! Alionekana amesisimka sana.

ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh! What could all this be about?
ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jamani! Haya yote yanaweza kuwa ya nini?

ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Do check on the other critters… they seem a bit more worried…
ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Waangalie wale wanyama wengine… wanaonekana na wasiwasi zaidi kidogo…

ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow check this out! The symbols are glowing!

ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea what this is about, but I’m pretty excited!
ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sijui kabisa hii ni nini, lakini nimesisimka sana!

ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, nothing really happens here too often… So I’m a bit more excited than worried about it…
ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kusema kweli, hakuna jambo linalotokea hapa mara nyingi… Kwa hiyo nimesisimka zaidi kidogo kuliko kuwa na wasiwasi…

ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides! If anything bad happens, I can just fly away! See ya!
ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isitoshe! Chochote kibaya kikitokea, naweza kuruka niondoke tu! Kwaherini!

ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure nothing bad will come of this… Right?
ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nina hakika hakuna jambo baya litakalotokana na hili… Sivyo?

ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And if something bad happens… We’ll figure it out together! We’re a scrappy bunch!
ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Na jambo baya likitokea… Tutalitatua pamoja! Sisi ni kundi lisiloshindwa kirahisi!

ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon love, there’s no need to get worked up just yet…
ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hebu mpenzi, bado hakuna haja ya kuvurugika…

ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]*Sigh* I’m sorry dear, I’m just on edge… This is very strange…
ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]*anapumua kwa huzuni* Samahani mpenzi, nina wasiwasi tu… Hili ni la ajabu sana…

ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, love. But we’ll be ok…

ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh Rascal, I’m glad to see you here. Look at what’s happening!
ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo Rascal, nimefurahi kukuona hapa. Angalia kinachotokea!

ds:339:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve got a bad feeling about this…

ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm, I don’t mean to snip dear, but I’ve been here my whole life and haven’t seen anything like this.
ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mmm, sikusudii kukufokea mpenzi, lakini nimekuwa hapa maisha yangu yote na sijawahi kuona kitu kama hiki.

ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If there was ever a time for concern, this is a pretty good one…
ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kama kuna wakati wa kuwa na wasiwasi, basi huu unafaa kabisa…

ds:33:22:Dialogue Text.source: … Yeah, definitely not going in there.

ds:340:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope we didn’t do anything wrong…

ds:340:5:Dialogue Text.source: What do you think about it?

ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These ruins have been here for so long… and we don’t know enough about them… What if we did something wrong?
ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Magofu haya yamekuwa hapa kwa muda mrefu sana… na hatujui vya kutosha kuyahusu… Vipi kama tumefanya jambo baya?

ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What do you think it could be?? A sign? A warning?

ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I probably should be – but I’m so curious!
ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huenda ninapaswa kuogopa – lakini nina udadisi mwingi sana!

ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rest of the critters say they’ve never seen this. They say it looks ominous. But I think it looks pretty!
ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wanyama wengine wote wanasema hawajawahi kuona hili. Wanasema linaonekana kuashiria mabaya. Lakini mimi naona linapendeza!

ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Rafiki, huenda mimi ni msafiri… Lakini wanyama hawa wananichukulia kama mmoja wao. Sitaki jambo lolote baya liwapate…

ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m doing well.
What do you make of all this?

ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I’m kinda scared… But also ready.
ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Rafiki, naogopa kidogo… Lakini pia niko tayari.

ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, I don’t know what’s coming up, but I’m prepared to do my part. Whatever needs to be done.
ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ndiyo, sijui kinachokuja, lakini nimejiandaa kutimiza wajibu wangu. Chochote kinachohitaji kufanywa.

ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Rafiki, huenda mimi ni msafiri… Lakini wanyama hawa wananichukulia kama mmoja wao. Sitaki jambo lolote baya liwapate…

ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to tell them a few times now. I’m pretty sure there’s nothin to worry about.
ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nimejaribu kuwaambia mara kadhaa sasa. Nina uhakika kiasi kwamba hakuna cha kuhofia.

ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, I recall stumbling across a writing that mentioned something like this.
ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Zamani, nakumbuka nikikumbana na andiko lililotaja kitu kama hiki.

ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though the writing didn’t mention why, or what it meant – it definitely didn’t mention any cataclysmic events afterward.
ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ingawa andiko halikutaja kwa nini, wala lilimaanisha nini – hakika halikutaja matukio yoyote ya maangamizi baada yake.

ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perhaps this is just a temporary phenomenon. Perhaps it’s something much more…
ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Labda hili ni tukio la muda tu. Labda ni jambo kubwa zaidi…

ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I don’t think anything bad will come of it.
ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini sidhani jambo lolote baya litatokana nalo.

ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to calm the critters down, but some of them can be pretty creative and get themselves worked up, heh.
ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nimejaribu kuwatuliza wanyama, lakini wengine wanaweza kubuni mambo sana na kujitia wasiwasi, heh.

ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I figured my time would be better spent studying this while it’s happening.
ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nikaona ni bora nitumie muda wangu kutafiti hili wakati linatokea.

ds:343:17:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, I should get back to it!

ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It didn’t make too much sense at the time, I thought perhaps I misinterpreted it, or perhaps it was a metaphor.
ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Halikuwa na maana iliyoeleweka sana wakati huo, nilidhani labda nimelifasiri vibaya, au labda lilikuwa sitiari.

ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]This is truly a sight to behold! I’ve never seen anything like this!
ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Haya ni mandhari ya ajabu kweli! Sijawahi kuona kitu kama hiki!

ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s so much to gleam from all of this.
ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini kuna mengi sana ya kujifunza kutokana na haya yote.

ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look, even the glyphs that are broken off of the monolith are glowing.
ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Angalia, hata alama za maandishi zilizovunjika kutoka kwenye jiwe kubwa zinang'aa.

ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should see my collection back home, so many little runes glowing ever so slightly. [pic=3]When I first saw it, I thought I was going mad!
ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ungeona mkusanyiko wangu nyumbani, runi nyingi ndogondogo zinang'aa kidogo sana. [pic=3]Nilipoziona mara ya kwanza, nilidhani nimeanza kuwa mwendawazimu!

ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.source:
A lot of the critters seem worried,
do you think this is a problem?
ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.target:
Wanyama wengi wanaonekana na wasiwasi,
unafikiri hili ni tatizo?

ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal, what’s all the commotion going on?
ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Habari Rascal, kelele zote hizi ni za nini?

ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s some stuff going on in the ruins.
You might wanna check it out!
ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Kuna mambo fulani yanaendelea magofuni.
Huenda ukataka kuyaangalia!

ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ruins? I’ve never seen any ruins here… but that sounds pretty interesting…
ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Magofu? Sijawahi kuona magofu yoyote hapa… lakini inasikika kuvutia kiasi…

ds:345:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:345:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Habari rafiki, kuna mambo gani yamekuwa yakiendelea?

ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard there’s some exciting things happening? I was about to go check it out.
ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nimesikia kuna mambo ya kusisimua yanatokea? Nilikuwa karibu kwenda kuona.

ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, the ruins have started glowing.
It’s pretty whacky.
ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.target:
Ndiyo, magofu yameanza kung'aa.
Ni jambo la ajabu sana.

ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, that’s quite bizarre. I’ll have to go see for myself.
ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hmm, hilo ni la ajabu kweli. Itabidi niende kuona mwenyewe.

ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, I hear there’s some crazy stuff going on…
ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Habari Mwekundu, nasikia kuna mambo ya kichaa yanatokea…

ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, some of the ruins are glowing…
You should check it out!
ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Ndiyo, baadhi ya magofu yanang'aa…
Unapaswa kwenda kuona!

ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep, just closing up the shop here first. Definitely gotta see this for myself…
ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ndiyo, nafunga duka hapa kwanza tu. Hakika lazima nione hii mwenyewe…

ds:347:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, let’s make a trip out there soon…

ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, as I was saying – your sweater is all done!
ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hata hivyo, kama nilivyokuwa nikisema – sweta yako imekamilika!

ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wait… there’s still a couple pins here…
ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Subiri… bado kuna pini mbili hivi hapa…

ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I agree! We did quite well with this one!

ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.source: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)
ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)

ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There he is! Good timing too, we just finished!
ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Huyo hapo! Na umefika wakati mwafaka, tumemaliza sasa hivi!

ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, that’s pretty normal. This is your first time, right?
ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ndiyo, hilo ni la kawaida kiasi. Hii ni mara yako ya kwanza, sivyo?

ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The fur can mingle with the cloth – but after a while it gets more comfortable
ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Manyoya yanaweza kuchanganyika na kitambaa – lakini baada ya muda inastarehesha zaidi

ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, when you look this fabulous, you can’t complain!
ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini hebu, ukiwa unapendeza hivi, huwezi kulalamika!

ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, don’t worry – You can wear it when you need to.

ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh, what was all that hubbub about?
ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini ee, zile kelele zote zilikuwa za nini?

ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You won’t hurt our feelings by not wearing it.

ds:347:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d prefer to see you nude anyways.

ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let us know if any seams come loose.

ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All of our clothes have a life time guarantee!
ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nguo zetu zote zina dhamana ya maisha yote!

ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Something’s going on.
Some of the glyphs at the ruins are glowing.
ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.target:
Kuna kitu kinaendelea.
Baadhi ya alama za maandishi magofuni zinang'aa.

ds:347:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Zinang'aa… Huh. Hilo ni la ajabu kiasi…

ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah~ That was fun! We ought to do that again real soon!
ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah~ Hilo lilifurahisha! Tunapaswa kulifanya tena hivi karibuni sana!

ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.source:
Definitely! Hopefully I can
last longer next time…
ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.target:
Bila shaka! Natumaini naweza
kudumu zaidi wakati mwingine…

ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.source:
I think I have a soft spot
for you smaller critters…
ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.target:
Nadhani nina udhaifu fulani
kwenu wanyama wadogo…

ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Magic Mabel Touch! No one can resist it!
ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ni Mguso wa Kichawi wa Mabel! Hakuna anayeweza kuupinga!

ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gotta say though, that tongue-bath was doin’ things for me.
ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini lazima niseme, kuoshwa kule kwa ulimi kulinisisimua.

ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s definitely a big button for me!
ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hakika hilo ni kichocheo kikubwa cha raha kwangu!

ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whew! Well that was a productive day!
ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Fiu! Basi hiyo ilikuwa siku yenye mafanikio!

ds:348:515:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m going to head back and chill.

ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes! We should do this again sometime!
ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ndiyo! Tunapaswa kufanya hivi tena wakati fulani!

ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say big guy, you free for a bit?

ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We were wondering if ya wanted to take us up on that romping we mentioned earlier…
ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Tulikuwa tukijiuliza kama unataka kukubali ule mchezo wa raha tulioutaja mapema…

ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been stretching all day! Now we can put some of that to the test!
ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Tumekuwa tukijitanua siku nzima! Sasa tunaweza kujaribu matokeo ya hayo!

ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not gonna lie, mate, always kinda wanted to have your claws riggling inside me…
ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sitasema uongo, rafiki, daima nimekuwa nikitamani kidogo kuhisi makucha yako yakijitikisa ndani yangu…

ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That sounds great! Some good ole’ fashion finger blasting!
ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Inasikika vizuri sana! Kuingiziwa vidole kwa nguvu kama zamani!

ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.source:
An order of finger blasting,
coming right up!
ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.target:
Agizo moja la kuingiziwa vidole kwa nguvu,
linakuja sasa hivi!

ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha ok you two, follow me. There’s a secluded area behind the bushes over there…
ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha sawa ninyi wawili, nifuateni. Kuna sehemu iliyojitenga nyuma ya vichaka vile…

ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ok Rascal! Lay on your back over there…

ds:349:323:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Now let’s climb on top of him.

ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.source: Damn mate, already flyin’ full mast eh?
ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.target: Dah rafiki, tayari umesimama wima kabisa, eh?

ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I think we’re ready… Watch those claws!
ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.target: Sawa, nadhani tuko tayari… Angalia makucha hayo!

ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.source: This is so much better than our toys Mabel!
ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.target: Hii ni bora sana kuliko vifaa vyetu vya ngono, Mabel!

ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.source: You two are pretty dang loose! That stretching is paying off!
ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.target: Ninyi wawili mmetanuka sana! Kujitanua kule kunazaa matunda!

ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve been working on depth too! I bet you can get two knuckles deep on me!
ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.target: Tumekuwa tukifanyia kazi kina pia! Nina hakika kwangu unaweza kuingia hadi vifundo viwili vya kidole!

ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, don’t go much further for me, mate!
ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, kwangu usiende mbali zaidi sana, rafiki!

ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.source: You’re right up on my prostate-nnngawd it feels great!
ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.target: Umefika kwenye tezi dume yangu-nnngjamani, ni raha sana!

ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Dustin, gimme a hand with this guy. I wanna see him squirt~!
ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.target: Hebu Dustin, nisaidie kwa huyu jamaa. Nataka kumwona akimwaga~!

ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, that’s right mate, let it all out~
ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, hivyo hivyo rafiki, mwaga yote~

ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh Dustin, you got some on your face…

ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.source: Come here, I can clean you two up…

ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.source: The very fibers of your being vibrate with joy.
ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.target: Kila chembe ya nafsi yako inatetemeka kwa furaha.

ds:34:22:Dialogue Text.target: Kazi ya sanaa ya fahari iliyoje!

ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.source: It is… an extremely magnificent piece…
ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.target: Ni… kazi ya sanaa ya fahari kupita kiasi…

ds:34:24:Dialogue Text.target: Ya ujasiri! Ya anasa! Hata ya kujionyesha!

ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.source: Standing in the presence of this piece makes you feel complete. Nay, FULFILLED!
ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.target: Kusimama mbele ya kazi hii kunakufanya ujihisi umekamilika. La, UMETOSHEKA!

ds:350:37:Dialogue Text.source: This stone… It’s warm to the touch…

ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.source: You can feel an immense power flowing from within…
ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.target: Unaweza kuhisi nguvu kubwa sana zikitiririka kutoka ndani…

ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Samahani Rascal, niko katikati ya shughuli fulani sasa... Nipe muda kidogo...

ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Samahani Rascal, niko katikati ya shughuli fulani sasa... Nipe muda kidogo...

ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.source: A bit! Those ruins were quite something!
ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.target: Kidogo! Magofu yale yalikuwa ya ajabu kweli!

ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they don’t scare ya off! I’ve grown used to your company!

ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.source: Nah, I’m here for the long run.
ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.target: Hapana, niko hapa kwa muda mrefu.

ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal! Good work again on the bridge! We appreciate your help!
ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Rascal! Kwa mara nyingine, kazi nzuri darajani! Tunashukuru kwa msaada wako!

ds:352:56:Dialogue Text.source: No problem! We make a great team!

ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.source: Let me know if you guys need anything else!

ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Our little town has some pretty interesting things going on huh?
ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Mji wetu mdogo una mambo ya kuvutia yanayoendelea, eh?

ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok not gonna lie, things got a lot more interesting when you arrived…
ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sawa, sitasema uongo, mambo yamekuwa ya kuvutia zaidi sana tangu ulipofika…

ds:353:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey so… When are we going on a date?

ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.source: We can go right now if you’d like!

ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Bah, I’ve got a thing in a bit…
ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Baa, nina shughuli fulani baada ya muda kidogo…

ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, you tell me when you’re ready!

ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Whattya think about those runes?

ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s mysterious! Adventerous! I feel like I’m in a book or something!
ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ni fumbo! Tukio la kusisimua! Nahisi kama niko katika kitabu au kitu kama hicho!

ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…
ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ingawa nahisi zamani mambo yalikuwa ya kuchosha zaidi kidogo…

ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!

ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nimefurahi sana kusikia hivyo! Tujulishe ukihitaji chochote, mpenzi~!

ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You should let us dress you up sometime.

ds:356:141:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not so sure about that one…

ds:356:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What did you make of those ruins?

ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I put it as an accent for my hat! It was spectacular while it was glowing!
ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nililiweka kama pambo la kofia yangu! Lilivutia sana lilipokuwa linang'aa!

ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But when the glowing stopped, I ditched it.

ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon Vi, you’re telling me you wouldn’t do the same?

ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*
ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*

ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Those glowing glyphs gave me some wicked cool ideas.
ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alama zile za maandishi zilizong'aa zilinipa mawazo mazuri ajabu.

ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’ll paint a series on it…

ds:357:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]About the stones? I mean, it’s pretty damn weird…

ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But uh, nothing bad seems to have happened.
ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini ee, hakuna jambo baya linaloonekana kutokea.

ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Things sure are pickin’ up with you around.

ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Somethin’ tells me things are just getting started!
ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ndiyo! Kuna kitu kinaniambia mambo ndiyo yanaanza tu!

ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rascal! Gosh, I’ve been learning a lot of stuff here!
ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Rascal! Jamani, nimekuwa nikijifunza mambo mengi hapa!

ds:358:163:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Do you know what’s going on?

ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve cross referenced a few things, and this has indeed happened before.
ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nimelinganisha marejeo kadhaa, na hakika hili limeshatokea zamani.

ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it was a VERY long time ago. Which is great news!
ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini ilikuwa zamani SANA. Hizo ni habari njema!

ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’d love to chat Rascal, but I’ve got a lot of stuff to look through.
ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ningependa kuzungumza, Rascal, lakini nina mambo mengi ya kupitia.

ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now that stuff’s gettin’ a lil weird in the forest, training is more important than ever!
ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sasa mambo yanapozidi kuwa ya ajabu kidogo msituni, mazoezi ni muhimu kuliko wakati wowote!

ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got a new routine set up if you’d like to give it a shot!
ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nimeandaa ratiba mpya ya mazoezi ukitaka kuijaribu!

ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Novice level! Whattya say, mate??

ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.source: Actually let’s do the Training Routine.
ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.target: Kwa kweli tufanye Ratiba ya Kujifunzia.

ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.source: On second thought, I’ll pass for now.

ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh, ya wanna try the Novice Track, eh? Great!
ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oooh, unataka kujaribu Njia ya Wanaoanza, eh? Vizuri!

ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So this one’s gonna be a lil different, mate, so pay attention!
ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo hii itakuwa tofauti kidogo, rafiki, zingatia!

ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]First, this one will be a bit longer. I’ve got a bit of a routine set up for ya!
ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwanza, hii itakuwa ndefu zaidi kidogo. Nimekuandalia ratiba fulani ya mazoezi!

ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Second, unlike the training, I’ll be going a lot harder are on ya, mate. So keep your eyes peeled!!
ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pili, tofauti na kujifunzia, hapa nitakukabili kwa ukali zaidi, rafiki. Kwa hiyo uwe macho!!

ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That said, I don’t want to hurt you, so i’ll stop the training if you get hit more than 3 times!
ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hata hivyo, sitaki kukuumiza, kwa hiyo nitasimamisha mazoezi ukipigwa zaidi ya mara 3!

ds:359:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mbali na hayo, kila kitu ni kilekile!

ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.source: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*
ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.target: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*

ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.source: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*
ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.target: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*

ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…
ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Eh heh… Ndiyo, samahani kwa hilo, rafiki…

ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?
ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Haha, hili libaki kati yetu tu, eh?

ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.source: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*
ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.target: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*

ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I got ya pretty good there, eh?

ds:359:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You’ll have to be quicker next time!

ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But eh, sorry if I went a lil hard!
ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini ee, samahani kama nimezidisha ukali kidogo!

ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Let me know if you want to try again!

ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!
ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Jamani rafiki! Unazidi kuwa hodari kweli wa hili!

ds:359:248:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna have to really step it up!

ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next challenge I’ll have for ya will be really tough, just you wait!
ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Changamoto nitakayokupa ijayo itakuwa ngumu sana, subiri tu!

ds:359:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m impressed! Happy to call you my pupil!

ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Looks like I got ya a couple times. But still, you beat the challenge!
ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Inaonekana nimekupata mara mbili hivi. Lakini bado umeshinda changamoto!

ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…
ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Eh heh… Ndiyo, samahani kwa hilo, rafiki…

ds:359:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?
ds:359:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Haha, hili libaki kati yetu tu, eh?

ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!
ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Jamani rafiki! Unazidi kuwa hodari kweli wa hili!

ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You win the personal satisfaction knowing your body and mind are growing healthier!
ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unashinda kuridhika binafsi kwa kujua mwili wako na akili yako vinazidi kuwa na afya bora!

ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well how about a romp in the bushes with your trainer?
ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Basi vipi mchezo wa raha vichakani na mkufunzi wako?

ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Whew! I don’t think I’m gonna be able to take that knot anytime soon…
ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Fiu! Sidhani nitaweza kupokea fundo hilo hivi karibuni…

ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not sure if this is something practice can make happen…
ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sina uhakika kama hili linaweza kuwezekana kwa mazoezi…

ds:359:763:Dialogue Text.source: I’m impressed you can fit me at all!
ds:359:763:Dialogue Text.target: Nimevutiwa kwamba hata unaweza kunipokea ndani yako!

ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah, well mate, you gotta give me some credit!
ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hah, basi rafiki, lazima unipe sifa kidogo!

ds:359:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m not your typical squirrel, after all.
ds:359:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mimi si kindi wa kawaida hata hivyo.

ds:359:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anyways, you keep up the good work!

ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next routine will be even more challenging!
ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ratiba ijayo ya mazoezi itakuwa na changamoto zaidi!

ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, this looks like it’s going to be a long walk!
ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm, inaonekana huu utakuwa mwendo mrefu!

ds:360:62:Dialogue Text.source: A piercing cold shoots through your body.

ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I pulled a lot of the hues from the glowing runes!
ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sivyo? Nimechukua rangi nyingi kutoka kwenye runi zinazong'aa!

ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’ve got this chilling quality to them, had to capture it!
ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Zina sifa fulani ya kutia baridi, ilinibidi kuionesha!

ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I wanted to capture this vast space.
ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sivyo? Nilitaka kuonyesha eneo hili pana sana.

ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Something that’s been there all along. Undisturbed, for centuries!
ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kitu ambacho kimekuwapo wakati wote. Bila kuguswa, kwa karne nyingi!

ds:360:72:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thanks buddy! Pretty proud of this one!

ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.source: A spacious illustration, featuring stunning crystal structures.
ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.target: Mchoro unaoonyesha nafasi kubwa, wenye miundo ya fuwele ya kuvutia sana.

ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.source: Where could such a place be? What could reside there?
ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.target: Mahali kama hapo panaweza kuwa wapi? Nini kinaweza kuishi huko?

ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…

ds:362:321:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See! He’s right there! Ask him now!

ds:362:332:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa hiyo mimi na Scarlett tulikuwa tukizungumza…

ds:362:333:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kuhusu zile ndoto za ngono nilizokuwa nazo…

ds:362:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I think I want to give it a go!

ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But the thing is… I wanna ease into it, with a lil private version, y’know?
ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Lakini jambo ni kwamba… nataka kuanza polepole, kwa namna ndogo ya faragha, unajua?

ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I’m a little strange when it comes to my intimate partners…
ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona, mimi ni wa ajabu kidogo inapohusu wenzi wangu wa faragha…

ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Either I know them very well like Scarlett here…
ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ama nawajua vizuri sana kama Scarlett huyu…

ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Or it’s a lot easier to do something uh… "unique" like this with folks I don’t know too well…
ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Au ni rahisi zaidi kufanya jambo ee… “la kipekee” kama hili na watu nisiowajua vizuri sana…

ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It can just be a lil awkward for me to try this with our other friends…
ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Inaweza kuwa hali ya aibu kidogo kwangu kujaribu hivi na marafiki zetu wengine…

ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.source: Well yeah! I’ve been doing the same thing here.
ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.target: Basi ndiyo! Nimekuwa nikifanya jambo lilelile hapa.

ds:362:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See! I told you he’d be down!

ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.source: When and where is this all goin’ down?
ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.target: Yote haya yatafanyika lini na wapi?

ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you aren’t busy now, we can use my basement!
ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kama huna shughuli sasa, tunaweza kutumia chumba changu cha chini ya nyumba!

ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]No worries honey, we can take this as slowly as ya want!
ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Usijali mpenzi, tunaweza kwenda polepole kadiri unavyotaka!

ds:362:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kwa kweli, tuingie moja kwa moja tu!

ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes ya gotta push the bird out of the nest, y’know? Bawkaw!
ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Wakati mwingine lazima umsukume ndege atoke kiotani, unajua? Bakaa!

ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! Now bend over so I can get this harness around you…
ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.target: Ndiyo! Sasa inama ili nikufunge mikanda hii kuzunguka mwili…

ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’m gonna put this ball gag on ya now, are ya ready?
ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.target: SAWA! Sasa nitakuvalisha hiki kiziba mdomo chenye mpira, uko tayari?

ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, do you want blinders on?
ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, unataka vizuizi vya macho pia?

ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.source: No, not this time. I’d like to see!
ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.target: Hapana, si wakati huu. Ningependa kuona!

ds:363:591:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view back there Rascal?

ds:363:593:Dialogue Text.source: Lookin’ great! Let me know when she’s ready!

ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.source: Aww look how cute she is with that ballgag on.
ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.target: Aa, angalia anavyopendeza akiwa amevaa kiziba mdomo hicho chenye mpira.

ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.source: Oop, you’re drooling a bit, lemme get that for ya!
ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.target: Lo, unadondokwa na mate kidogo, ngoja nikufutie!

ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.source: I’m gonna start warming her up back here, is that ok!
ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.target: Nitaanza kumwandaa huku nyuma, ni sawa!

ds:363:608:Dialogue Text.target: Jamani! Tayari ana unyevunyevu mwingi sana!

ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, that’s my girl! She’s my absolute favorite to play with for that very reason!
ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, huyo ndiye msichana wangu! Hiyo ndiyo sababu yenyewe yeye ndiye ninayependa zaidi kuchezeana naye!

ds:363:612:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I’m gonna go for it.

ds:363:620:Dialogue Text.source: How are ya doin’ back there?

ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.source: Haven’t done this with a bird before!

ds:363:628:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, she’s close, I can tell.

ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh Rascal, you were really gettin’ in there!
ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.target: Jamani Rascal, ulikuwa ukiingia ndani kabisa!

ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya blame me? You’re so soft back here!
ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.target: Unaweza kunilaumu? Wewe ni laini sana huku nyuma!

ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal… You know there’s two holes in there, right?
ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal… Unajua kuna matundu mawili ndani humo, sivyo?

ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, y’know. I thought I felt something different every so often…
ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, unajua. Nilidhani nahisi kitu tofauti mara mojamoja…

ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.source: You are my first bird. I hope I didn’t hurt you.
ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.target: Wewe ndiye ndege wangu wa kwanza. Natumaini sikukuumiza.

ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.source: No no, it was quite exciting! I didn’t know what to expect, and that’s the whole allure of this thing!
ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.target: Hapana, hapana, ilisisimua sana! Sikujua cha kutarajia, na huo ndio mvuto wote wa jambo hili!

ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.source: Gah, dear you’re so cute when you’re satisfied, I simply must smooch you~
ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.target: Gah, mpenzi, unapendeza sana ukiwa umeridhika, lazima nikubusu~

ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.source: Baww haha, thanks for this you two…
ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.target: Baa haha, asanteni kwa hili, ninyi wawili…

ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.source: Think you’re ready to go public?
ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.target: Unafikiri uko tayari kufanya hivi hadharani?

ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.source: Haha that’s ok- Oh, I think she wants the gag out.
ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, ni sawa- Oo, nadhani anataka kiziba mdomo kitolewe.

ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.source: But I definitely want to do this again…
ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.target: Lakini hakika nataka kufanya hivi tena…

ds:363:666:Dialogue Text.source: I haven’t had a go with ya yet!

ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve got a few toys I think you’d love…
ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.target: Nina vifaa vya ngono vichache ambavyo nadhani utavipenda…

ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, I’d love to see that! But gosh I’m beat.
ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, ningependa kuona hivyo! Lakini jamani nimechoka sana.

ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.source: I think I’ll leave you two to it!

ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.source: Aw, ok hun. Thanks for helping me out!
ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.target: Aa, sawa mpenzi. Asante kwa kunisaidia!

ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.source: We’ll catch you up on our shenanigans later!

ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for warming her up for me!
ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.target: Asante kwa kumwandaa kwa ajili yangu!

ds:363:678:Dialogue Text.source: Now for the real fun to begin…

ds:364:25:Dialogue Text.source: The entrance is a little bit of a squeeze…

ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.source: You can see a lot of miscellaneous cloth materials scattered about.
ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.target: Unaweza kuona vitambaa vingi vya aina mbalimbali vimetapakaa.

ds:365:30:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like the path continues here…

ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.source: This must be where Augustus lives… But he’s not home at the moment…
ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.target: Lazima hapa ndipo Augustus anaishi… Lakini hayuko nyumbani kwa sasa…

ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.source: You can make out a bunch of papers and rocks inside.
ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.target: Unaweza kutambua karatasi na mawe mengi ndani.

ds:367:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hmm… This one I didn’t quite finish…

ds:367:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Kinda got bored of it halway through.
ds:367:84:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nilichoshwa nao kidogo nikiwa nusu ya kazi.

ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Instead of wasting my time or paint, it’s a better idea to just stop and try something else.
ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Badala ya kupoteza muda au rangi yangu, ni bora kuacha tu na kujaribu kitu kingine.

ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.source: A vast space, with a single illuminated rune.
ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.target: Eneo pana sana, lenye runi moja yenye mwanga.

ds:367:90:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll try this one again sometime.

ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had a striking idea in my head, but as I started painting, the idea kinda shifted to this.
ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nilikuwa na wazo la kushangaza kichwani, lakini nilipoanza kuchora, wazo likabadilika kidogo kuwa hivi.

ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But it’s not as striking as I wanted it to be, so maybe next time.
ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini haushangazi kama nilivyotaka, kwa hiyo labda wakati mwingine.

ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.source: As you focus on the symbol, you could feel your vision tunneling…
ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.target: Unapoikazia macho alama, unaweza kuhisi uoni wako ukibana kama handaki…

ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.source: Looks spooky! Do you often to portraits?
ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.target: Unaonekana wa kutisha! Unachora taswira za watu mara nyingi?

ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t! Well, not for fun at least.
ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sifanyi hivyo! Basi, angalau si kwa kujifurahisha.

ds:368:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I do the occasional study here and there.
ds:368:107:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mara mojamoja nafanya michoro ya kujifunzia hapa na pale.

ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I dreamt this figure up a bit ago. I had to try to capture it!
ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini nilimwona kiumbe huyu ndotoni kitambo kidogo. Ilinibidi nijaribu kumchora!

ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I don’t think I fully got it… but… still came out pretty well.
ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sidhani nimemnasa kikamilifu… lakini… bado umetoka vizuri kiasi.

ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.source:
Say, are there creatures
like that in this forest?
ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.target:
Hebu, kuna viumbe
kama huyo katika msitu huu?

ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not that I’ve seen! But who knows.

ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.source: A fierce creature peers back at you.

ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.source: Its eyes are captivating… They seem to be analyzing everything about you…
ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.target: Macho yake yanakuvutia… Yanaonekana kuchunguza kila kitu kuhusu wewe…

ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s a few other critters that you’ve yet to meet.
ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kuna wanyama wengine kadhaa ambao bado hujakutana nao.

ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll go ahead and jot them down in your Quest Log - I’m sure you’ll meet them on your own. But you can read up on it there!
ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nitawaandika katika Daftari lako la Misheni - nina hakika utakutana nao mwenyewe. Lakini unaweza kusoma habari zao humo!

ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve met all the critters here, I’ll have a special request for ya!
ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ukishakutana na wanyama wote hapa, nitakuwa na ombi maalumu kwako!

ds:36:17:Dialogue Text.source: this convo exists so we can ensure all quest steps have a nonnull db conversation (saves a heckton of null checks in the source code!)

ds:370:582:Dialogue Text.target: Huyo rafiki yako ni nani, Claire?
