ds:389:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I know she’s a bit less up front than the rest of us, I wonder if this is one of her hidden kinks?
ds:389:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Najua yeye si wa kusema moja kwa moja kama sisi wengine, najiuliza kama hii ni mojawapo ya tamaa zake zilizofichika?

ds:389:404:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basi, kuna jambo jingine lililotokea usiku huo?

ds:389:406:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Great! Yeah, I’ve heard many retellings of this night, but the critters always start talking over each other and disagreeing on the timing of certain things.
ds:389:406:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Vizuri! Ndiyo, nimesikia masimulizi mengi ya usiku huu, lakini wanyama daima huanza kuzungumza kwa kukatizana na kutokubaliana kuhusu wakati mambo fulani yalipotokea.

ds:389:407:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s nice to set things straight finally!

ds:389:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hm… I Wonder if I’ll try a kissing booth again next year…
ds:389:408:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hm… Najiuliza kama nitajaribu kibanda cha mabusu tena mwaka ujao…

ds:389:409:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, thank you for finding all that out for me Rascal!
ds:389:409:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hata hivyo, asante kwa kunigundulia yote hayo, Rascal!

ds:389:410:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anything I can do to repay you?

ds:389:412:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hah! Ok, you got it, hot stuff!

ds:38:132:Dialogue Text.source: A set of gardening tools. They’ve gotten a ton of use.
ds:38:132:Dialogue Text.target: Seti ya zana za bustani. Zimetumika sana.

ds:390:260:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]As you can guess, I take on the roll of the Bell Bearer.
ds:390:260:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kama unavyoweza kukisia, mimi huchukua jukumu la Mbeba Kengele.

ds:390:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Partly to play out the role, but also…
ds:390:261:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa kiasi fulani ni kuigiza jukumu hilo, lakini pia…

ds:390:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I do go on look out for any critters that might be struggling in the cold.
ds:390:262:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hutoka kuangalia kama kuna wanyama wanaoweza kuwa wakitaabika kwa baridi.

ds:390:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There has been a few occasions where I have found critters in need of help. Much like how I found you!
ds:390:263:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kumekuwa na nyakati chache ambapo nimewapata wanyama wanaohitaji msaada. Kama nilivyokupata wewe!

ds:390:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But mainly I just go around visiting other areas. It’s always nice seeing other critters ringing out their bells to me in celebration too!
ds:390:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini hasa mimi huzunguka kutembelea maeneo mengine. Daima inapendeza kuona wanyama wengine pia wakinipigia kengele zao kwa shangwe!

ds:390:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But my experience of the celebration is a bit different than the other critters here…
ds:390:267:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini uzoefu wangu wa sherehe ni tofauti kidogo na wa wanyama wengine hapa…

ds:390:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]He insists that there is this "Saint" character that played a role during the Blessing.
ds:390:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Anasisitiza kwamba kuna mhusika huyu “Mtakatifu” aliyekuwa na jukumu wakati wa Baraka.

ds:390:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But that’s not how I’ve heard it.

ds:390:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]In any case, there’s a whole other part of the festivities that I don’t partake in because I’m prepping for the actual Blessing.
ds:390:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa vyovyote vile, kuna sehemu nyingine nzima ya sherehe ambayo sishiriki kwa sababu najiandaa kwa Baraka yenyewe.

ds:390:272:Dialogue Text.source: I see! Ok, I will talk to him.

ds:390:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks for asking about this though! I’m happy to teach folks about this since it’s a time that’s very close to my heart!
ds:390:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini asante kwa kuuliza kuhusu hili! Ninafurahi kuwafundisha watu kwa kuwa ni wakati ulio karibu sana na moyo wangu!

ds:390:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Critters had no choice but to band together. They would exchange and share provisions, huddle for warmth, and share in eachother’s company.
ds:390:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Wanyama hawakuwa na chaguo ila kuungana. Walibadilishana na kugawana mahitaji, wakakusanyika kujipasha joto, na kufarijiana kwa kuwa pamoja.

ds:390:277:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But they knew it wouldn’t last, they knew they needed help.
ds:390:277:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Lakini walijua hali hiyo isingedumu, walijua walihitaji msaada.

ds:390:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So each night, when the weather was the most still, the critters would ring their bells for hope that anyone would hear it.
ds:390:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kwa hiyo kila usiku, hali ya hewa ilipokuwa imetulia zaidi, wanyama walipiga kengele zao wakitumaini yeyote angezisikia.

ds:390:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Day after day, new critters would show up, share in the warmth and comfort others could provide, and night after night, they would ring their bells.
ds:390:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Siku baada ya siku, wanyama wapya walifika, wakishiriki joto na faraja ambayo wengine waliweza kutoa, na usiku baada ya usiku, walipiga kengele zao.

ds:390:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Weeks went by. Until finally, on the 18th night, a heavy sound rung out from the skies.
ds:390:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Wiki zikapita. Hadi hatimaye, usiku wa 18, sauti nzito ikasikika kutoka angani.

ds:390:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The familiar sound of a bell, but this one was much larger… It grew louder and louder. It was coming closer!
ds:390:281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sauti inayojulikana ya kengele, lakini hii ilikuwa kubwa zaidi sana… Ikazidi kuwa kubwa na kubwa. Ilikuwa inakaribia!

ds:390:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]On the 19th night, a great falcon was spotted in the distance.
ds:390:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Usiku wa 19, kipanga mkubwa alionekana kwa mbali.

ds:390:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]The bird carried a tremendous bell, ringing out far into the night.
ds:390:283:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Ndege huyo alibeba kengele kubwa sana, ikiita mbali usiku.

ds:390:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The critters calls were heard, they were answered!
ds:390:284:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Miito ya wanyama ilikuwa imesikika, ilikuwa imejibiwa!

ds:390:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The Falcon circled overhead, ringing out their giant bell. And the critters joined in with their own chorus of bells!
ds:390:285:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kipanga alizunguka juu yao, akipiga kengele yake kubwa. Na wanyama wakaungana naye kwa sauti za kengele zao wenyewe!

ds:390:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Within hours, a rescue team came barreling after the falcon, providing food and water to all.
ds:390:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Baada ya saa chache, kikosi cha uokoaji kikaja kwa kasi kikimfuata kipanga, kikitoa chakula na maji kwa wote.

ds:390:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thus, The Blessing of the Bells became a widespread story. A necessity for winter survival back in the day.
ds:390:287:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hivyo, Baraka za Kengele zikawa hadithi iliyoenea. Jambo la lazima kwa kuishi wakati wa majira ya baridi zamani.

ds:390:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I go flying around with a BIG OLE BELL ringing across the lands!
ds:390:289:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mimi huzunguka nikiruka na KENGELE KUBWA SANA ikiita kote nchini!

ds:390:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Critters down below will join me ringing out their own bells as I pass by. It’s a wonderful time!
ds:390:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wanyama huko chini huungana nami kwa kupiga kengele zao ninapopita. Ni wakati mzuri sana!

ds:390:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It really is! It’s a magical time, and I’m super grateful I can be a part of it!
ds:390:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kweli ni hivyo! Ni wakati wa kichawi, na ninashukuru sana kuwa naweza kushiriki!

ds:390:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Did Scarlett tell you why this is a holiday at all? Where it all started?
ds:390:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Scarlett alikuambia kwa nini hii ni sikukuu hasa? Yote yalianzia wapi?

ds:390:295:Dialogue Text.source: She said I should hear it from you.

ds:390:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well The Blessing of the Bells has become much more superficial these days.
ds:390:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basi Baraka za Kengele siku hizi zimekuwa zaidi za mambo ya juu juu.

ds:390:298:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gift giving, partying, decorations, friends and family, y’know how it goes…
ds:390:298:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kupeana zawadi, karamu, mapambo, marafiki na familia, unajua mambo yanavyokwenda…

ds:390:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But it actually started in much darker times…
ds:390:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Lakini kwa kweli zilianza katika nyakati zenye giza zaidi sana…

ds:390:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, the Winters were very harsh, and times were much tougher. Provisions were harder to come by, and larger communities like ours were quite scarce.
ds:390:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Zamani sana, majira ya baridi yalikuwa makali sana, na nyakati zilikuwa ngumu zaidi. Mahitaji yalikuwa magumu kupatikana, na jamii kubwa kama yetu zilikuwa chache sana.

ds:390:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Snowy seasons were quite dangerous. If a family didn’t prepare, there were dire consequences…
ds:390:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Misimu ya theluji ilikuwa hatari sana. Familia isipojiandaa, kulikuwa na matokeo mabaya sana…

ds:390:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]One terrible Winter, the winds blew harder than ever, the snow was relentless, the temperatures were unbearable.
ds:390:302:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Katika majira fulani mabaya ya baridi, upepo ulivuma kwa nguvu kuliko wakati wowote, theluji haikukoma, baridi haikuvumilika.

ds:390:306:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh it’s a wonderful time! Lots of the critters here get into the spirit of things.
ds:390:306:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, ni wakati mzuri sana! Wanyama wengi hapa hushiriki kwa moyo wa sherehe.

ds:390:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I hope you’ll join us for the next one!

ds:390:308:Dialogue Text.source:
I’d like to!
Can you tell me more about it?

ds:390:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a month long celebration, where critters bundle up, decorate their surroundings, share gifts and meals!
ds:390:310:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ni sherehe ya mwezi mzima, ambapo wanyama hujifunika nguo za joto, hupamba mazingira yao, hupeana zawadi na kushiriki chakula!

ds:390:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We close out each night of celebration with a ringing of a bell!
ds:390:311:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tunamalizia kila usiku wa sherehe kwa kupiga kengele!

ds:390:312:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Then do the whole thing over the next day!

ds:390:314:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It is! And that’s not even the best part!
ds:390:314:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ni kweli! Na hiyo hata si sehemu bora zaidi!

ds:390:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The very last day, yours truly finishes the entire celebration with "The Blessing!"
ds:390:315:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Siku ya mwisho kabisa, mimi mwenyewe namalizia sherehe nzima kwa “Baraka!”

ds:390:318:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve heard you know a thing or two
about The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:390:318:Dialogue Text.target:
Nimesikia unajua jambo moja au mawili
kuhusu Baraka za Kengele?

ds:391:260:Dialogue Text.source:
I was wondering if you could
tell me about The Blessing of the Bells
ds:391:260:Dialogue Text.target:
Nilikuwa najiuliza kama unaweza
kuniambia kuhusu Baraka za Kengele

ds:391:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh? Isn’t it a little early to be thinking of that?

ds:391:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s the middle of Summer after all…

ds:391:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Er wait, have you celebrated The Blessing before?

ds:391:264:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve just learned about it.
Penny said you could tell me more.
ds:391:264:Dialogue Text.target:
Nimejifunza kuzihusu sasa hivi tu.
Penny alisema unaweza kuniambia zaidi.

ds:391:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes, you’ve come to the right gator!

ds:391:266:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Knowing Penny, she’s likely told you the cultural and historical significance already?
ds:391:266:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ninavyomjua Penny, huenda ameshakuambia umuhimu wake wa kitamaduni na kihistoria?

ds:391:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m assuming she told you to come to me to hear about The Saint?
ds:391:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nadhani alikuambia uje kwangu kusikia kuhusu Mtakatifu?

ds:391:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Haha, I bet she wasn’t too keen on telling you that part…
ds:391:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Haha, nina hakika hakutamani sana kukuambia sehemu hiyo…

ds:391:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed… See cultural holidays will vastly change over generations.
ds:391:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hakika… Unaona, sikukuu za kitamaduni hubadilika sana kadiri vizazi vinavyopita.

ds:391:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It can be hard to tell what stemmed from legitimacy, and what was added for fun.
ds:391:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Inaweza kuwa vigumu kujua nini kilitokana na ukweli, na nini kiliongezwa kwa kujifurahisha.

ds:391:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]To Penny’s credit, I can’t say I’ve seen records of "The Saint" being involved with The Blessing…
ds:391:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kumtendea Penny haki, siwezi kusema nimeona kumbukumbu za “Mtakatifu” kuhusika na Baraka…

ds:391:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But as a child, this aspect was a favorite of mine for the festivities. I’m definitely guilty of perpetuating this nonsense, but it’s so fun!
ds:391:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini nilipokuwa mtoto, sehemu hii ndiyo niliyoipenda katika sherehe. Hakika nina hatia ya kuendeleza upuuzi huu, lakini unafurahisha sana!

ds:391:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right - so, you’re generally familiar with the origins of The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:391:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sawa - kwa hiyo, kwa ujumla unajua asili ya Baraka za Kengele?

ds:391:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well it’s been said that there was a mysterious critter going around providing small boons and gifts to the young.
ds:391:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basi imesemekana kulikuwa na mnyama wa ajabu aliyekuwa akizunguka kuwapa vijana misaada midogomidogo na zawadi.

ds:391:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Likely to keep their mind off of such perilous times.
ds:391:281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Huenda ili wasifikirie nyakati hizo zenye hatari sana.

ds:391:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Again, no official records of that happening - But the myth became tradition!
ds:391:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tena, hakuna kumbukumbu rasmi za hilo kutokea - Lakini hekaya ikawa desturi!

ds:391:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s customary to give each other gifts during this holiday, but it’s also customary to give some gifts in total anonymity, thus continuing on the spirit of "The Saint".
ds:391:283:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ni desturi kupeana zawadi wakati wa sikukuu hii, lakini pia ni desturi kutoa baadhi ya zawadi bila kujulikana kabisa, hivyo kuendeleza moyo wa “Mtakatifu”.

ds:391:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And there’s no secret that I try to play that role during our celebrations…
ds:391:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Na si siri kwamba najaribu kuigiza jukumu hilo wakati wa sherehe zetu…

ds:391:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Believe me, it’s QUITE TRICKY for a fella like me to provide gifts without being noticed…
ds:391:287:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Niamini, ni VIGUMU SANA kwa mwenzenu kama mimi kutoa zawadi bila kuonekana…

ds:391:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Even I receive some of these anonymous gifts… Like truly anonymous.
ds:391:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hata mimi hupokea baadhi ya zawadi hizi zisizojulikana chanzo… Yaani kweli hazijulikani.

ds:391:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, it’s always easy to tell when a critter here is "trying" to be secretive.
ds:391:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Unaona, daima ni rahisi kutambua mnyama wa hapa “anapojaribu” kufanya siri.

ds:391:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ll occasionally get a truly mysterious gift, and try as I might, no one seems to know where it comes from.
ds:391:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini mara mojamoja hupata zawadi yenye fumbo kweli, na hata nikijitahidi vipi, hakuna anayeonekana kujua imetoka wapi.

ds:391:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]All the critters know I’m supposed to be "The Saint" - so they often think I’m messing with them.
ds:391:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wanyama wote wanajua mimi ndiye ninayepaswa kuwa “Mtakatifu” - kwa hiyo mara nyingi wanafikiri ninawatania.

ds:391:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I swear to you, I’ve no idea who keeps gifting me things during the festivities.
ds:391:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini nakuapia, sijui ni nani anayeendelea kunipa vitu wakati wa sherehe.

ds:391:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.
ds:391:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ni wazi lazima awe mnyama wa hapa, na kwa kweli ninafurahi tu kuona moyo wa Mtakatifu ukiendelea kuishi.

ds:391:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, will you be joining us for this year’s Blessing?
ds:391:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hata hivyo, utajiunga nasi kwa Baraka za mwaka huu?

ds:391:298:Dialogue Text.source: I hope so! It sounds amazing!

ds:391:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It really is a special time here for us.
ds:391:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hakika ni wakati wa kipekee hapa kwetu.

ds:391:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I know I don’t speak for myself when I say we’d love to have you!
ds:391:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Najua sijisemei peke yangu ninaposema tungependa uwe nasi!

ds:391:301:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for telling me about all of this!

ds:392:260:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…

ds:392:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was gonna pick up some veggies for a stew…

ds:392:264:Dialogue Text.source: I only ever see like, 3 things for sale.
ds:392:264:Dialogue Text.target: Huwa naona vitu kama 3 tu vinauzwa.

ds:392:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah he’s got stuff in the back. No idea why there’s only ever 3 things on display here…
ds:392:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ndiyo, ana vitu nyuma. Sijui kwa nini huwa kuna vitu 3 tu vilivyowekwa mbele hapa…

ds:393:375:Dialogue Text.source:
Do you remember Scarlett’s party
during the last Blessing of the Bells?
ds:393:375:Dialogue Text.target:
Unakumbuka karamu ya Scarlett
wakati wa Baraka za Kengele zilizopita?

ds:393:376:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm, you’ll have to be a bit more specific than that!
ds:393:376:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmmm, itabidi ueleze kwa usahihi zaidi kidogo kuliko hivyo!

ds:393:377:Dialogue Text.source:
Claire and Violet said you guys
all got up to some naughty stuff.
ds:393:377:Dialogue Text.target:
Claire na Violet walisema ninyi
wote mlifanya mambo fulani ya utundu.

ds:393:379:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon mate, you remember stuffin’ my rear, don’t ya?

ds:393:382:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah but yes, now it’s coming back to me.

ds:393:384:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh that’s right, Claire and Violet were wearing their festive colors eh?
ds:393:384:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo kweli, Claire na Violet walikuwa wamevaa rangi zao za sherehe, eh?

ds:393:389:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep! The those coyotes might be evil, but they keep their word!
ds:393:389:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ndiyo! Huenda koyoti wale ni waovu, lakini wanatimiza ahadi zao!

ds:393:390:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… That was a good time, we should do that again…
ds:393:390:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Ulikuwa wakati mzuri, tunapaswa kufanya hivyo tena…

ds:393:398:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, I wouldn’t mind being on the tongue-bath side of you going at Dustin.
ds:393:398:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unajua, singekataa kuwa upande wa kuogeshwa kwa ulimi huku ukimwingilia Dustin.

ds:393:400:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oy! Why am I always on bottom?
ds:393:400:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ehee! Kwa nini daima mimi ni mwenye kupokea?

ds:393:403:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What? A lil guy like you being a top? You crazy?
ds:393:403:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nini? Mdogo kama wewe kuwa mwenye kuingiza? Una wazimu?

ds:393:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Red, those girls are evil, you know that right?
ds:393:408:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lakini Mwekundu, wale wasichana ni waovu, unajua hivyo, sivyo?

ds:393:413:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Back me up Dustin, we were watching those two lick on Mabel, right?
ds:393:413:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nisaidie hapa, Dustin, tulikuwa tukiwatazama wale wawili wakimlamba Mabel, sivyo?

ds:393:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And Red, those tongues? WOW. They get everywhere. It’s great.
ds:393:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Na Mwekundu, ndimi zile? LO. Zinafika kila mahali. Ni vizuri sana.

ds:393:420:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So there Dustin and I were, watching this show. And y’know, we’re gettin’ pretty excited.

ds:408:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Have you heard of a book called Lyllith the Dragonslayer?
ds:408:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Umesikia kuhusu kitabu kinachoitwa Lyllith Muuaji wa Majoka?

ds:408:120:Dialogue Text.source: He jostled his tongue around, and her hips bucked in response.
ds:408:120:Dialogue Text.target: Akautikisa ulimi wake huku na kule, na nyonga zake zikaruka kuitikia.

ds:408:121:Dialogue Text.source: The familiar thrusting started as she let out a moan.
ds:408:121:Dialogue Text.target: Misukumo ile inayojulikana ikaanza huku akitoa mguno.

ds:408:122:Dialogue Text.source: The dragon’s tongue slipped in and out. Fluids ran down his jaw and neck.
ds:408:122:Dialogue Text.target: Ulimi wa joka uliingia na kutoka. Majimaji yakatiririka kwenye taya na shingo yake.

ds:408:125:Dialogue Text.source: The wolf hadn’t been with a partner that truly satisfied her for a long time.
ds:408:125:Dialogue Text.target: Mbwa-mwitu hakuwa na mwenzi aliyemridhisha kweli kwa muda mrefu.

ds:408:128:Dialogue Text.source: By the time they were done, it was late, and they collapsed into a warm, panting heap.
ds:408:128:Dialogue Text.target: Walipomaliza, ilikuwa imechelewa, nao wakaanguka pamoja katika joto, wakihema hema.

ds:408:129:Dialogue Text.source: And though the sex was fantastic, Volkyn wanted nothing more than to stay in this moment…
ds:408:129:Dialogue Text.target: Na ingawa ngono ilikuwa ya ajabu, Volkyn hakutaka kitu kingine ila kubaki katika wakati huu…

ds:408:131:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to Game* *Camera close up on Charlotte*
ds:408:131:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to Game* *Camera close up on Charlotte*

ds:408:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just loved this part of the book. So much passion and-
ds:408:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Niliipenda sana sehemu hii ya kitabu. Hamu nyingi sana na-

ds:408:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh… <pause>I just read some pretty raunchy stuff…<pause> That’s embarassing…
ds:408:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jamani… <pause>Nimesoma tu mambo ya ngono yaliyo wazi sana…<pause> Inatia aibu…

ds:408:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nonsense dear, that was a wonderful story!
ds:408:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Usiseme hivyo mpenzi, ilikuwa hadithi nzuri sana!

ds:408:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Lyllith The Dragonslayer, right? She’s anything but embarassing!
ds:408:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lyllith Muuaji wa Majoka, sivyo? Yeye hana jambo lolote la kuona aibu!

ds:408:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m getting to it, I’m getting to it!

ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a spinoff from a larger series called Scales And Tails. It’s a bunch of books in a low fantasy world.
ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ni tawi la mfululizo mkubwa zaidi unaoitwa Magamba na Mikia. Ni vitabu kadhaa katika ulimwengu wa aina ya low fantasy.

ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I thought y’all were forming an angry mob to finally throw me out!
ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nilidhani mnakusanya kundi lenye hasira ili hatimaye mnifukuze!

ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Instead I got to hear about this hot story!
ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Badala yake nikasikia hadithi hii ya kusisimua!

ds:408:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Right? I gotta get my paws on these books!

ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh sure! Whenever Claire finishes, you can borrow that copy!
ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, bila shaka! Claire akimaliza, unaweza kuazima nakala hiyo!

ds:408:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thank you for sharing that with us!

ds:408:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Would you guys…<pause> Be interested in another story some time?

ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]All the books intertwine and tell a huge epic story filled with adventure, mystery, love, and death! It’s amazing!
ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Vitabu vyote vinaungana na kusimulia hadithi kubwa ya kishujaa iliyojaa matukio ya kusisimua, mafumbo, mapenzi, na kifo! Ni ya ajabu!

ds:408:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! I’ll be sure to find something fun!

ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See the title is also a play-on-words! Lyllith the Dragon SLAYER? or Lyllith the Dragon’s <bounce>LAYER!</bounce>
ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona, hata jina lina mchezo wa maneno! Lyllith MUUAJI wa Majoka? Au Lyllith <bounce>MLALAJI</bounce> na Majoka!

ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Buuuut, she’s only been with one dragon so far… <pause>There’s a slew of other creatures for sure, so…
ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakiiini, hadi sasa amekuwa na joka mmoja tu… <pause>Kuna viumbe wengine wengi, bila shaka, kwa hiyo…

ds:408:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maybe that’s just hinting at what’s to come.

ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you can guess, Lyllith is the main character…
ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo kama unavyoweza kukisia, Lyllith ndiye mhusika mkuu…

ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.target: Lyllith ni mbwa-mwitu! Ni mkali asiyeogopa, anaongozwa na haki, na amejaa nguvu za kimama!

ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.target: Ni mpiganaji wa kulipwa na kwa kawaida huzunguka kwenye vilabu vya pombe hadi apate kazi.

ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.source: A Job… Or a partner for the night.
ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.target: Kazi… Au mwenzi wa usiku huo.

ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.source: One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.target: Usiku mmoja hasa, anasikia kuhusu joka anayewatia hofu wakazi wa mji ulio karibu…

ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.source: Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.target: Sasa Lyllith ameshakabiliana na majoka kabla. Wanaweza kuwa wakali kidogo, lakini hakuna asichoweza kuhimili.

ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.target: Lakini hakuna kiasi cha vifaa ambacho kingemwandaa kwa joka huyu…

ds:408:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We were just passing by and got caught up in your story!
ds:408:42:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tulikuwa tukipita tu tukavutwa na hadithi yako!

ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No no, it’s a book series I really like. I was just telling Rascal about it.
ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hapana, hapana, ni mfululizo wa vitabu ninaoupenda sana. Nilikuwa nikimweleza Rascal tu kuuhusu.

ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh that’s great! Again, don’t mind us, we’re just here to listen.
ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, ni vizuri sana! Tena, usitujali, tuko hapa kusikiliza tu.

ds:408:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do go on! I love hearing about how couples meet!

ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ooooh! Yeah these two actually had some pretty rough beginnings!
ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ooooh! Ndiyo, kwa kweli hawa wawili walianza kwa shida sana!

ds:408:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Are you ready for our book club?
ds:408:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Uko tayari kwa klabu yetu ya vitabu?

ds:408:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The entire second book was about the random circumstances they would cross eachother’s paths, and butt heads.
ds:408:50:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kitabu chote cha pili kilihusu mazingira ya sadfa yaliyowakutanisha njiani, na kuwafanya wagombane.

ds:408:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well…<pause> Rivals turned co-workers…<pause> Turned co-workers with benefits?
ds:408:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basi…<pause> Washindani wakawa wafanyakazi wenza…<pause> Wakawa wafanyakazi wenza wanaopeana raha ya ngono?

ds:408:54:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There was a nice little Winter scene that sums up how their dynamic is…
ds:408:54:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kulikuwa na tukio dogo zuri la Majira ya Baridi linalofupisha walivyo pamoja…

ds:408:58:Dialogue Text.source: It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
ds:408:58:Dialogue Text.target: Ulikuwa usiku mtulivu. Theluji mpya ilicheza angani kabla ya kutua mashavuni na midomoni mwao mirefu.

ds:408:5:Dialogue Text.source: Oh… Was I supposed to read something…?

ds:408:60:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
ds:408:60:Dialogue Text.target: Volkyn (huyo ndiye joka) anamtazama mbwa-mwitu kwa sura ya kusikitisha.

ds:408:61:Dialogue Text.source: "Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
ds:408:61:Dialogue Text.target: “Lyllith… <pause>T-tafadhali, niache nitumie joho lako… <pause>Nina b-b-b-baridi sana…”

ds:408:62:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
ds:408:62:Dialogue Text.target: Lyllith anajua vizuri kabisa kwamba hali hii ya hewa si kitu kwake.

ds:408:63:Dialogue Text.source: Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
ds:408:63:Dialogue Text.target: Bila kutaja kwamba joho lake lingekuwa kama kitambaa cha kufutia mdomo kwa joka.

ds:408:65:Dialogue Text.source: Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
ds:408:65:Dialogue Text.target: Hata hivyo, anamwendekeza na kumpa joho.

ds:408:66:Dialogue Text.source: This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
ds:408:66:Dialogue Text.target: Hii ilimshangaza, alidhani hakika asingekubali kufanya hivyo.

ds:408:67:Dialogue Text.source: But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
ds:408:67:Dialogue Text.target: Lakini alifanya hivyo, na sasa ilimbidi ajue jinsi ya kukifunga hiki kitu kidogo shingoni.

ds:408:69:Dialogue Text.source: And despite it being a joke at first…

ds:408:70:Dialogue Text.source: It’s the little gestures that really get to him.

ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!
ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aa! Ni zile nyakati ndogondogo za kuungana kwa dhati zinazogusa moyo!

ds:408:76:Dialogue Text.source: They’ve been here for a while.

ds:408:77:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yeah we wanted to see what you guys were up to!

ds:408:78:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah sorry! I didn’t mean to interrupt! I just got lost in the cuteness…
ds:408:78:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ndiyo, samahani! Sikukusudia kukukatiza! Nilizama tu katika uzuri huo…

ds:408:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve always wanted to be a part of a book club though!
ds:408:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini daima nimetaka kushiriki klabu ya vitabu!

ds:408:80:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, it’s just a scene and some characters from a book!
ds:408:80:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, ni tukio tu na wahusika fulani kutoka kwenye kitabu!

ds:408:81:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal asked if I had any favorite books, and I was telling him about this one.
ds:408:81:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal aliuliza kama nina vitabu ninavyovipenda zaidi, nami nilikuwa nikimweleza kuhusu hiki.

ds:408:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! Haha, I wasn’t expecting an audience heh!

ds:408:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about… <pause>I turn up the heat and tell ya guys about one of the scenes between the two?
ds:408:84:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vipi… <pause>Niongeze joto na kuwaeleza kuhusu mojawapo ya matukio kati ya hao wawili?

ds:408:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Blimey, between a Dragon and a Wolf?

ds:408:86:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huo ni mchezo mtamu wa tofauti za ukubwa…

ds:408:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now close your eyes and imagine for a second…
ds:408:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sasa fungeni macho na muwaze kwa muda kidogo…

ds:408:8:Dialogue Text.source: Ah! Maybe we can make one here!
ds:408:8:Dialogue Text.target: Aa! Labda tunaweza kuanzisha moja hapa!

ds:408:91:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s see… Ah! Here we are…

ds:408:94:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith let out a gasp. Her body was trembling. Every part of her was on fire, she wanted MORE.
ds:408:94:Dialogue Text.target: Lyllith alivuta pumzi kwa mshtuko. Mwili wake ulikuwa ukitetemeka. Kila sehemu yake ilikuwa ikiwaka moto, alitaka ZAIDI.

ds:408:95:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s fingers slipped further inside her. He was gentle, but his strength and size was apparent.
ds:408:95:Dialogue Text.target: Vidole vya Volkyn vikaingia ndani yake zaidi. Alikuwa mpole, lakini nguvu na ukubwa wake vilionekana wazi.

ds:408:96:Dialogue Text.source: As his fingers explored her, he gently nipped and licked at her neck.
ds:408:96:Dialogue Text.target: Vidole vyake vilipomchunguza, aliuma kwa upole na kulamba shingo yake.

ds:408:97:Dialogue Text.source: "Nnf ahh~!" Lyllith moaned. She’d taken on many dragons before… But not like this…
ds:408:97:Dialogue Text.target: “Nnf ahh~!” Lyllith aliguna. Aliwahi kukabiliana na majoka wengi kabla… Lakini si hivi…

ds:408:99:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s muzzle met hers. Lyllith’s mouth was ajar, panting. He took that as an invitation.
ds:408:99:Dialogue Text.target: Mdomo wa Volkyn ukakutana na wake. Mdomo wa Lyllith ulikuwa wazi kidogo, akihema. Akaichukulia hiyo kama mwaliko.

ds:409:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hey Mel, would you please get me the cookies?

ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.source: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*
ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.target: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*

ds:409:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]M-Melody isn’t here right now, p-please come back later!
ds:409:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]M-Melody hayuko hapa sasa, t-tafadhali rudi baadaye!

ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*
ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*

ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?
ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hebu Rascal… Najua tumekutana sasa hivi tu, lakini naweza kuomba msaada?

ds:409:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
ds:409:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sijamwona Charlotte akiwa amesisimka hivi kwa muda.

ds:409:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?
ds:409:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unaweza kufanya chochote atakachoomba kwa muda kidogo?

ds:409:738:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!
ds:409:738:Dialogue Text.target: Nilikuwa nimepanga kufanya hivyo hata hivyo!

ds:409:740:Dialogue Text.source:
Errr, sorry I didn’t mean to scare you.
I’m just a visitor.
ds:409:740:Dialogue Text.target:
Eeee, samahani, sikukusudia kukutisha.
Mimi ni mgeni tu.

ds:409:742:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, I came to the forest a few days ago.
I’m new here.
ds:409:742:Dialogue Text.target:
Ndiyo, nilifika msituni siku chache zilizopita.
Mimi ni mpya hapa.

ds:409:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I see… Do you just walk into critter’s houses where you come from?
ds:409:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Naona… Mlikotoka huwa mnaingia tu nyumbani mwa wanyama?

ds:409:744:Dialogue Text.source: Well you don’t exactly have a door…

ds:409:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:409:747:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly I’m surprised you haven’t heard of me.
I thought gossip traveled fast in the forest…
ds:409:747:Dialogue Text.target:
Kusema kweli, nashangaa hujasikia habari zangu.
Nilidhani porojo huenea haraka msituni…

ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…
ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aa, tumejitenga kidogo huku juu… Na mara nyingi napenda kukaa kivyangu…

ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.source: Um, I can leave if you want.

ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.
ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, hapana, ni sawa. Umenishtua tu bila kutarajia.

ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.
ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nimefurahi kukutana nawe. Naona wewe si wa maeneo haya.

ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!
ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Panda mwekundu, sivyo? Hii ni mara ya kwanza kumwona mmoja!

ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! I’ve come to experience
"the love!" of the forest!
ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.target:
Ni kweli! Nimekuja kuonja
“mapenzi!” ya msitu!

ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…
ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Basi hayo ni zaidi mambo ya Melody…

ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.
ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na unaweza kuchukua muda wote unaohitaji mpaka uwe tayari, mpenzi.

ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…
ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini kwa kweli, siku yoyote kuanzia sasa ingekuwa vizuri sana…

ds:409:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?

ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.
ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ilinibidi kuhakikisha hujaribu kumuumiza Charlotte wangu mdogo maskini.

ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!
ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kama nina hakika umeshakisia, mimi ni Melody!

ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…
ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hatukutarajia wageni, la sivyo ningekuwa nimetayarisha chai…

ds:409:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?

ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.source: Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?

ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.
ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo ndiyo, tuliweka vitu vyake kwenye sanduku.

ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…

ds:409:787:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

ds:409:789:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.

ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…
ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Unaona Rascal, tulikuwa wasumbufu kidogo kama watu wa kuishi nao…

ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…
ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Lakini hakika tungeweza kujaribu kwa bidii zaidi kidogo…

ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!

ds:40:253:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal! I was just out wandering!

ds:410:203:Dialogue Text.target: Kuna vitabu vya kila aina hapa!

ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Looks like some adult titles?
ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.target: Oo? Inaonekana kuna vitabu fulani vya watu wazima?

ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.source: Ok this whole bottom section is erotic novels…
ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.target: Sawa, sehemu hii yote ya chini ni riwaya za ngono…

ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Oh uh! Melody is pretty picky about critters going into her room.
ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Oo ee! Melody ni mchaguzi sana kuhusu wanyama wanaoingia chumbani kwake.

ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]She doesn’t even let me in there that often…
ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Hata mimi haniruhusu kuingia huko mara nyingi…

ds:410:211:Dialogue Text.target: Za kumtosha mnyama wa jamii ya mbwa?

ds:411:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Can’t wait to cook with you sometime!

ds:411:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Always happy to see you around here!

ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, darling. I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal, mpenzi. Sijamwona Charlotte akiwa amesisimka hivi kwa muda.

ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?
ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unaweza kufanya chochote atakachoomba kwa muda kidogo?

ds:412:749:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!
ds:412:749:Dialogue Text.target: Nilikuwa nimepanga kufanya hivyo hata hivyo!

ds:412:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:412:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t wait to see you go next!

ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Alright Rascal… I’ve got a plan, but I’ll need your help.
ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sawa Rascal… Nina mpango, lakini nitahitaji msaada wako.

ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I’ve been meaning to meet the critters of the forest, right?
ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kwa hiyo, nimekuwa nikikusudia kukutana na wanyama wa msituni, sivyo?

ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And we also need to patch up our relationship with Finley, right?
ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na pia tunahitaji kurekebisha uhusiano wetu na Finley, sivyo?

ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I have a way to do both!
ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nadhani nina njia ya kufanya yote mawili!

ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I need you to help break the ice, what do you say?
ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini nahitaji unisaidie kuvunja barafu ya kufahamiana, unasemaje?

ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No Rascal, I’m asking for your help. Please be serious!
ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hapana Rascal, ninaomba msaada wako. Tafadhali chukulia kwa uzito!

ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I like to bake, and I’m pretty good if I do say so myself.
ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Unaona, napenda kuoka, na ninajua vizuri kiasi, niseme mwenyewe.

ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’m not good at meeting new folks…
ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini sijui vizuri kukutana na watu wapya…

ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And the last time I tried, I scared them off by accident…
ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Na mara ya mwisho nilipojaribu, niliwatisha wakaondoka bila kukusudia…

ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m willing and really wanting to put in the work, but if you could help me out, I’d be very grateful!
ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Niko tayari na ninataka sana kujitahidi, lakini ukiweza kunisaidia, nitashukuru sana!

ds:413:148:Dialogue Text.source: Why not have Melody do it?

ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s out going and great with people for sure… But we’re both basically strangers to the rest of the critters…
ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bila shaka yeye ni mchangamfu na anajua kuhusiana na watu… Lakini sisi wote wawili kimsingi ni wageni kwa wanyama wengine…

ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This would just make things smoother, if you don’t mind!
ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hii ingefanya mambo yaende kwa urahisi zaidi tu, kama hutojali!

ds:413:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! Well first I need to get baking.

ds:413:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Of course I’ll help out!
Though I might charge a cookie tax…
ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Bila shaka nitasaidia!
Ingawa huenda nikatoza kodi ya biskuti…

ds:413:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So why not break the ice with some extra special "friendship cookies"!
ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kwa hiyo kwa nini tusivunje barafu ya kufahamiana kwa “biskuti za urafiki” za kipekee sana!

ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Biskuti hizi zimeokwa sasa hivi, bado zina joto na ziko tayari kupelekwa!

ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and here’s that special one for Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, na hii hapa ile maalumu ya Finley… Hakikisha anajua imetoka kwetu!

ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, biskuti zimeokwa sasa hivi, bado zina joto na ziko tayari kupelekwa!

ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Give that special one to Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mpe Finley ile maalumu… Hakikisha anajua imetoka kwetu!

ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, biskuti zimeokwa sasa hivi, bado zina joto na ziko tayari kupelekwa!

ds:414:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Be sure to give some to all the critters!

ds:415:717:Dialogue Text.source: This one’s from a new friend!

ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.source: Nope! Have ya met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.target: Hapana! Umekutana na Charlotte na Melody?

ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! Yes the bear and fox up in the caves, right?
ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aa! Ndiyo, dubu na mbweha wa juu mapangoni, sivyo?

ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve seen them here and there, but very seldomely.
ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nimewaona hapa na pale, lakini mara chache sana.

ds:415:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Umm… Can I take a few more?

ds:416:737:Dialogue Text.source: Actually, I have something for ya!

ds:416:740:Dialogue Text.source: It is! I hope you like cookies!

ds:416:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks Rascal! This is very nice of you!

ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually they’re from Charlotte and Melody!
I’m just the delivery boy.
ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Kwa kweli zimetoka kwa Charlotte na Melody!
Mimi ni kijana wa kuleta mzigo tu.

ds:416:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, vizuri sana! Charlotte ni mwokaji hodari!

ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna be more active
with the critters down here.
ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.target:
Wanataka kuchangamana zaidi
na wanyama wa huku chini.

ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m a bit familiar with them, but obviously they’re a little large to use my services.
ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ninawafahamu kidogo, lakini ni wazi ni wakubwa kidogo kutumia huduma zangu.

ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And frankly, no one really goes up there - but there is a perch! That’s a part of my route!
ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na kusema kweli, hakuna anayeenda huko juu hasa - lakini kuna kituo cha kutua! Hicho ni sehemu ya njia yangu!

ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Hmm, I don’t think I have a spare bell though… I really have to make more…
ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Hmm, lakini sidhani nina kengele ya ziada… Lazima nitengeneze nyingine zaidi…

ds:416:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]They might have a spare one up there…

ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I mean, it’s not like they use the one I gave them!

ds:417:737:Dialogue Text.source: Have you met Melody and Charlotte?

ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The polar bear and the fox gal, right?
ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dubu wa ncha ya kaskazini na yule mwanadada mbweha, sivyo?

ds:417:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I have wanted to meet em!

ds:417:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve got a thing for big ladies, mate!

ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See lil’ guys like myself can uh… get in pretty deep if ya know what I’m sayin.
ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Unaona, wadogo kama mimi wanaweza ee… kuingia ndani sana, kama unaelewa ninachosema.

ds:417:746:Dialogue Text.source: I think I catch your drift.

ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho a guy can dream! For now, toss one of those cookies over!
ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hata hivyo, mwanaume anaweza kuota! Kwa sasa, nirushie mojawapo ya biskuti hizo!

ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I gotta load up on carbs anyways, so this is perfect!
ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lazima nijaze wanga hata hivyo, kwa hiyo hii inafaa kabisa!

ds:418:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If it isn’t Rascal! How are you dear?

ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m good! And I’ve got
cookies for the two of you!
ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.target:
Niko vizuri! Na nina
biskuti kwa ajili yenu wawili!

ds:418:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hold on love! I’ll make sure they aren’t poison…

ds:418:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I’ll need to test yours as well…

ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If these are poison, it’ll just be the end of me!
ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kama hizi zina sumu, basi huo utakuwa mwisho wangu!

ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Also, how dare you insinuate our lil’ Rascal would poison us!
ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pia, unawezaje kudokeza kwamba Rascal wetu mdogo angetuwekea sumu!

ds:418:746:Dialogue Text.source: Actually they aren’t made by me!

ds:418:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have to ask her for the recipe!

ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mm, yes! It’s that depth of savory, but the hint of salty…
ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mm, ndiyo! Ni kile kina cha ladha yenye kunoga, lakini kidokezo cha chumvi…

ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m going to tell her you’re making these jokes.

ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Maybe there’s rabbit in these cookies…
ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Labda kuna sungura ndani ya biskuti hizi…

ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.source: Do you two know Charlotte and Melody?
ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.target: Ninyi wawili mnawajua Charlotte na Melody?

ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes! The critters up North. They don’t frequent these parts too often.
ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aa ndiyo! Wanyama wa huko Kaskazini. Hawaji maeneo haya mara nyingi sana.

ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve always wanted to make a trek up there and meet them. But it’s awfully cold up there!
ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Daima nimetaka kutembea mpaka huko na kukutana nao. Lakini kuna baridi kali sana huko juu!

ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.source: Claire and Violet knitted me a sweater.

ds:418:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I bet you’re absolutely adorable in it!

ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Funny thing about those critters up north…
ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kuna jambo la kuchekesha kuhusu wale wanyama wa kaskazini…

ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I haven’t met them, but I was out scavenging, and the bear… Charlotte, was it?
ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sijakutana nao, lakini nilikuwa nje nikiokota vitu, na yule dubu… Charlotte, sivyo?

ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’s awfully quiet for how large she is!

ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She managed to sneak up on me, and I ended up having a bit of a fright!
ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aliweza kunijia bila kusikika, nami nikaishia kuogopa kidogo!

ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I didn’t quite realize who it was, so I bolted.
ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sikutambua kabisa ni nani, kwa hiyo nikakimbia.

ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It dawned on me later, but I never got the chance to mention it! It’d be a laugh now!
ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Niligundua baadaye, lakini sikupata nafasi ya kutaja hilo! Sasa lingetuchekesha!

ds:418:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s right! You had quite a fright that day.

ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s not every day you see a bear in the woods!

ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Or, did she poison these cookies to finish the job?!
ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Au, ameweka sumu kwenye biskuti hizi ili amalizie kazi?!

ds:419:736:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m delivering cookies!
Here ya go!

ds:419:739:Dialogue Text.source: This seems like a good problem to have.
ds:419:739:Dialogue Text.target: Hili linaonekana tatizo zuri kuwa nalo.

ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can’t possibly eat this much! It’ll take a week to finish it!
ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siwezi kula kiasi kikubwa hivi! Itachukua wiki moja kuimaliza!

ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Break me off a piece. You can have the rest of mine.
ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nivunjie kipande. Unaweza kuchukua iliyobaki ya yangu.

ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Who made these? A frickin’ bear or something?
ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nani ametengeneza hizi? Dubu fulani au nini?

ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.source:
Yes actually! Have you
met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Ndiyo, kwa kweli! Umekutana
na Charlotte na Melody?

ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I haven’t! But I have heard about them.

ds:419:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dubu wa ncha ya kaskazini na mbweha wa Aktiki, sivyo?

ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow, and they can bake? Oh these are great too!
ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lo, na wanajua kuoka? Oo, na hizi ni nzuri sana!

ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! They want to meet everyone.
ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.target: Ndiyo! Wanataka kukutana na kila mtu.

ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well they’re off to a great start! Gosh these cookies are killer!
ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Basi wameanza vizuri sana! Jamani, biskuti hizi ni nzuri ajabu!

ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perfect timing! I’ve been bored as hell.
ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Umefika wakati mwafaka! Nimekuwa nikihisi kuchoshwa kupita kiasi.

ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you’ve also met our boy, Ollie!
ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naona pia umekutana na kijana wetu, Ollie!

ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.source: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)
ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.target: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)

ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, we’re fuck buddies. He’s always so bashful about it. It’s adorable.
ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Haha, sisi ni marafiki wa kutombana. Daima huwa na haya sana kuhusu hilo. Inapendeza.

ds:41:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Claire, You’re gonna scare this new guy off.

ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]C’mon Vi, You can smell it, this boy’s been up to a lot already!
ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hebu Vi, unaweza kunusa, huyu kijana tayari amefanya mengi sana!

ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Of course I can smell it, I’m just being polite.
ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bila shaka naweza kunusa, nina adabu tu.

ds:41:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll just see what the new guy thinks.

ds:41:231:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about it new guy, are we scaring you?

ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh come on Vi, he’s clearly messing with us.

ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s what I’m talking about! Look at him, this guy’s GOT it.
ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hayo ndiyo mambo! Mwangalie, huyu jamaa ANAJUA.

ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Say… You came at a pretty good time.

ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe you can help us figure something out…

ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, I don’t think so Vi, he’s already agreed to help us.
ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Haha, sidhani hivyo Vi, tayari amekubali kutusaidia.

ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Which one of us would make you cum faster?
ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ni yupi kati yetu angekufikisha kileleni haraka zaidi?

ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.source: Only one way to find out…
ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.target: Kuna njia moja tu ya kujua…

ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! I’m beat. Thanks for being the judge there.
ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Fiu! Nimechoka. Asante kwa kuwa mwamuzi hapo.

ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Huh? For me? Aren’t I the one who handles deliveries?
ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huh? Wangu? Si mimi ndiye ninayeshughulikia mizigo ya kupelekwa?

ds:420:741:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:420:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, the fox and bear up north?

ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! They wanna be more
friendly and active with you guys.
ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Ni kweli! Wanataka kuwa na urafiki
na kuchangamana zaidi nanyi.

ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’d be great! I’d love to see them more often!
ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ingekuwa vizuri sana! Ningependa kuwaona mara nyingi zaidi!

ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Mmm~ These cookies rock too! Top tier cookies if I do say so myself.
ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mmm~ Na biskuti hizi ni nzuri ajabu! Biskuti za daraja la juu, niseme mwenyewe.

ds:420:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Remember that camera I was fiddling with?

ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it’s good to go! Let me know if you meet any critters that might wanna do some modeling!
ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Basi iko tayari! Nijulishe ukikutana na wanyama wowote wanaoweza kutaka kupiga picha za uanamitindo!

ds:420:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe Charlotte or Melody would be interested!

ds:420:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ndiyo! Tutengeneze vitu fulani vya kusisimua kingono!

ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.source:
Isn’t that a little too forward
for new critters?
ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.target:
Huko si kwenda moja kwa moja sana
kwa wanyama wapya?

ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Folks don’t live around these parts and expect paid dinner and three dates!
ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Watu hawaishi maeneo haya wakitarajia kulipiwa chakula cha jioni na miadi mitatu ya kimapenzi!

ds:420:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure you’ve realized that by now!

ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Atta’ boy! And gimme another cookie before you leave!
ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Huyo ndiye kijana wangu! Na nipe biskuti nyingine kabla hujaondoka!

ds:421:740:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.source:
They live up north, but they haven’t
really come down here that often.
ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.target:
Wanaishi huko kaskazini, lakini hawajakuwa
wakienda huku chini mara nyingi.

ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanted to be neighborly!
Break the ice, so to speak.
ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Walitaka kuwa na urafiki wa ujirani!
Kuvunja barafu ya kufahamiana, tuseme hivyo.

ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh I shoulda done that! Everyone likes food!
ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oooh, nilipaswa kufanya hivyo! Kila mtu anapenda chakula!

ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gosh, it’s a little hard for someone like me to cook though…
ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lakini jamani, ni vigumu kidogo kwa mtu kama mimi kupika…

ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They seem like nice critters! I’ll be looking forward to meeting them!
ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wanaonekana wanyama wema! Nitakuwa na hamu ya kukutana nao!

ds:421:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh… And… Can I have another cookie?

ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?
ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Hmm, hapana. Ninanusa wanyama wengine mwilini mwake… Melody?

ds:422:743:Dialogue Text.source: Yep, that’s right! You know them?

ds:422:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bila shaka! Melody ni rafiki yetu wa karibu!

ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We don’t really know her roommate, Charlotte. But we DO know her baking!
ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hatufahamu sana mwenzake wa nyumba, Charlotte. Lakini TUNAJUA uokaji wake!

ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna get to know
the critters around here.

ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s great! We’ve been trying to egg them on to do it for a while.
ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ni vizuri sana! Tumekuwa tukijaribu kuwahimiza wafanye hivyo kwa muda.

ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Finley used to be roommates with them. We’d all hang every so often.
ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lakini Finley alikuwa akiishi nyumba moja nao. Sote tulikuwa tukikaa pamoja mara mojamoja.

ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll also join Melody on her excursions!
ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pia tunajiunga na Melody kwenye matembezi yake!

ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Those were usually to other parts of the forest though. Not in this neighborhood.
ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ingawa kwa kawaida yalikuwa kwenye sehemu nyingine za msitu. Si katika mtaa huu.

ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’d go looking for random one night flings.
ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tulienda kutafuta watu wa kujifurahisha nao kwa usiku mmoja.

ds:422:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should join us if we ever go again!

ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.source:
And Charlotte made cookies!
This one’s for you specifically.
ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.target:
Na Charlotte ameoka biskuti!
Hii ni yako wewe hasa.

ds:423:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, man, I do miss her baking…

ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aw look, it says "We’re Sorry" heh… Looks like they’re trying, eh?
ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Aa angalia, imeandikwa “Tunaomba Radhi” heh… Inaonekana wanajitahidi, eh?

ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oooh, and look here, they cleaned all my belongings!
ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oooh, na angalia hapa, wamesafisha mali zangu zote!

ds:423:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kusema kweli, ni jambo dogo la kipuuzi kidogo…

ds:423:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Umewahi kuwa na mwenzako wa Nyumba, Rascal?

ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, not all critters have the same standards I suppose!
ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Basi, nadhani si wanyama wote wana viwango vilevile!

ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It was a weird lesson to learn, and we never really… concluded it too well together.
ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lilikuwa somo la ajabu kujifunza, na hatukulimaliza hasa… vizuri sana pamoja.

ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]In the heat of the moment, it was very aggravating, but now I can see that not all critters are compatible in terms of living situations.
ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Wakati ule hisia zilipokuwa kali, lilikera sana, lakini sasa naona kwamba si wanyama wote wanaopatana kuhusu kuishi pamoja.

ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]On the surface, it was mainly that they were really messy…
ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kwa nje, hasa ilikuwa kwamba walikuwa wachafu na wasio na mpangilio sana…

ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Clothes and trash on the floor. Kitchen a total mess.
ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nguo na takataka sakafuni. Jikoni fujo tupu.

ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was the one cleaning most of it, and I have hooves! Not an easy task!
ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mimi ndiye niliyekuwa nikisafisha sehemu kubwa ya hayo, na nina kwato! Si kazi rahisi!

ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Melody would even borrow my gear and forget to clean it! Yuck!
ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Melody hata alikuwa akiomba vifaa vyangu kisha anasahau kuvisafisha! Kichefuchefu!

ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But what it really seemed to be, was a lack of respect. To me and their living space.
ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lakini ilionekana kwa kweli kuwa ukosefu wa heshima. Kwangu na kwa mahali walipoishi.

ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, you were up there, right? You probably saw the mess.
ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yaani, ulikuwa huko juu, sivyo? Huenda uliona fujo.

ds:423:760:Dialogue Text.target: Vyombo vimepangwa kwa kurundikwa, kaunta safi.

ds:423:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Really?? And the clothes on the floor?

ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.source:
There was a clothing rack.
Didn’t see much on the floor.
ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.target:
Kulikuwa na kishikio cha kuning'inizia nguo.
Sikuona nyingi sakafuni.

ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And Charlottes books? Those had to be around right?
ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Na vitabu vya Charlotte? Hivyo lazima vilitapakaa, sivyo?

ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.source:
Nope, on a book case.
Alphabetized I believe.
ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.target:
Hapana, kwenye kabati la vitabu.
Vimepangwa kialfabeti, nadhani.

ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hah. Of course. They get their act together once I’m gone.

ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah well, at least they seemed to have taken my complaints seriously…
ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aa basi, angalau inaonekana wameyachukulia malalamiko yangu kwa uzito…

ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well. It’s not very becoming of me to let these petty things stack up and ruin some friendships. I should go talk to them.
ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basi. Haipendezi kwangu kuacha mambo haya madogo ya kipuuzi yajikusanye na kuharibu urafiki. Ninapaswa kwenda kuzungumza nao.

ds:424:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh! Now what do we have here?

ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Gosh, I probably shouldn’t… I’ve eaten a lot of sweets lately…
ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! Jamani, huenda sipaswi… Nimekula vitamu vingi hivi karibuni…

ds:424:738:Dialogue Text.source: Oh but these are friendship cookies!
ds:424:738:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, lakini hizi ni biskuti za urafiki!

ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh I see! Well then of course there’s room for a friendship cookie!
ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, naona! Basi bila shaka kuna nafasi ya biskuti ya urafiki!

ds:424:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I didn’t peg you as a baker!

ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s because I’m not! These are
from the critters in the mountains!
ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.target:
Hiyo ni kwa sababu si mimi! Hizi
zimetoka kwa wanyama wa milimani!

ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah what was their names… Medley… Charlene?
ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aa, majina yao yalikuwa yapi… Medley… Charlene?

ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah yes! That’s right. I did some work for them a bit ago.
ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aa ndiyo! Ni kweli. Niliwafanyia kazi fulani kitambo kidogo.

ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Some of my finer work! And it was my first time working in ice too! Tricky stuff!
ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mojawapo ya kazi zangu bora! Na ilikuwa mara yangu ya kwanza kufanya kazi kwenye barafu pia! Mambo magumu!

ds:424:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I wonder if that’s still holding up…

ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I gotta go deliver more cookies.
ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.target: Sawa, lazima niende kupeleka biskuti zaidi.

ds:424:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good! Pass my compliments to the chef!

ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.source:
Didn’t you say something about
having too many sweets lately?
ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.target:
Si ulisema kitu kuhusu
kula vitamu vingi sana hivi karibuni?

ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.source:
Well there’s always room
for Friendship Cookies!
ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.target:
Basi daima kuna nafasi
ya Biskuti za Urafiki!

ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha that’s right! I’ll be sure to savor this one!
ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, ni kweli! Nitahakikisha naikula hii kwa kuifurahia!

ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mpenzi! Nipe dakika chache nami nitatafuta vitu vya Finley.

ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mpenzi! Nipe dakika chache nami nitatafuta vitu vya Finley.

ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll gather up Finley’s stuff.
ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mpenzi! Nipe dakika chache nami nitakusanya vitu vya Finley.

ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Here you go, darling! This box should be everything Finley left up here.
ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haya hapa, mpenzi! Sanduku hili linapaswa kuwa na kila kitu Finley alichoacha huku juu.

ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yes, we took you for granted and were just terrible roommates!
ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ndiyo, hatukukuthamini na tulikuwa wabaya sana kuishi nao!

ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now now, I also have my fair share of the blame. I’ve never been good at confronting these things…
ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sasa, sasa, nami pia nina sehemu yangu ya lawama. Sijawahi kuwa hodari wa kuyakabili mambo haya…

ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should have tried to communicate more before things blew up.
ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nilipaswa kujaribu kuwasiliana zaidi kabla mambo hayajalipuka.

ds:428:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But if we didn’t suck, you wouldn’t have to communicate!

ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]And we’re sorry we left things like this for so long.
ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Na tunaomba radhi kwa kuacha mambo hivi kwa muda mrefu sana.

ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]We felt awful after you left, and we weren’t sure how to make it up to you…
ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tulijisikia vibaya sana ulipoondoka, na hatukuwa na uhakika wa jinsi ya kukufidia…

ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]All we could do was hear your words and try to do better…
ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tulichoweza tu ni kuyasikia maneno yako na kujaribu kufanya vizuri zaidi…

ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But we never knew how to fix things…
ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Lakini hatukujua kamwe jinsi ya kurekebisha mambo…

ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s fine it’s fine. I should have come up sooner honestly.
ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ni sawa, ni sawa. Kusema kweli nilipaswa kuja huku mapema zaidi.

ds:428:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Nilishikilia mambo madogo ya kipuuzi kupita kiasi…

ds:428:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Does… Does this mean you’ll come back?

ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Uhhh! Well. I think we all learned some important things about ourselves…
ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Eeee! Basi. Nadhani sote tumejifunza mambo muhimu kuhusu sisi wenyewe…

ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think it’d be best for me to be on my own for now…
ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Nadhani ingekuwa bora niishi peke yangu kwa sasa…

ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But… How about we do dinner together?
ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Lakini… Vipi tukila chakula cha jioni pamoja?

ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve got some new recipes I bet you two would enjoy.
ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nina mapishi mapya ambayo nina hakika ninyi wawili mtayapenda.

ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That sounds wonderful, Finley. We’ll happily have you over whenever you want.
ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hilo linasikika vizuri sana, Finley. Tutafurahi kukukaribisha nyumbani wakati wowote unaotaka.

ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh uh. So I see you two have met Rascal, yeah?
ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo ee. Basi naona ninyi wawili mmekutana na Rascal, eh?

ds:428:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yes we have! Come on over dear, we see you!
ds:428:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ndiyo, tumekutana naye! Njoo hapa mpenzi, tunakuona!

ds:429:716:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry, I didn’t mean to intrude!

ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]On the contrary, dear! I think we owe you one for helping us patch things up!
ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kinyume chake, mpenzi! Nadhani tuna deni lako kwa kutusaidia kupatana!

ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.source:
Pretty sure that was
the magic of Charlotte’s cookies.
ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.target:
Nina uhakika kiasi kwamba hizo zilikuwa
nguvu za kichawi za biskuti za Charlotte.

ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true, I’m really just here for more cookies.
ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ni kweli, kwa kweli niko hapa kupata biskuti zaidi tu.

ds:429:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! I knew it. I can’t blame you.

ds:429:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yes yes, my cookies are great.
ds:429:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Heh, ndiyo, ndiyo, biskuti zangu ni nzuri sana.

ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But what is a cookie without a delivery service! That was all you Rascal!
ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lakini biskuti ina maana gani bila huduma ya kupeleka! Hiyo ilikuwa kazi yako yote, Rascal!

ds:429:727:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s true.
I am a miracle worker.
ds:429:727:Dialogue Text.target:
Ni kweli.
Mimi ni mtenda miujiza.

ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! To thank Rascal, we should have him join us for dinner sometime!
ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! Kumshukuru Rascal, tunapaswa kumwalika ale nasi chakula cha jioni wakati fulani!

ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hey uh Melody… regarding the toys you were borrowing…
ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hebu ee Melody… kuhusu vifaa vya ngono ulivyokuwa ukiazima…

ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Forgive me for asking, but I’m awfully curious. Did the big one fit?
ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nisamehe kwa kuuliza, lakini nina udadisi mwingi sana. Kile kikubwa kilitoshea?

ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh? Quite the nosy one Finley! I can’t believe you’d ask a gal something so personal…
ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo? Una udadisi wa kuingilia sana, Finley! Siamini kwamba ungemwuliza mwanamke jambo la binafsi hivi…

ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, ok cut the coy act! You know you’re doing that just because Rascal is here.
ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, sawa, acha kuigiza haya! Unajua unafanya hivyo kwa sababu tu Rascal yuko hapa.

ds:429:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]There’s no impression like the first impression, darling…
ds:429:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hakuna kama jinsi watu wanavyokuona mkikutana mara ya kwanza, mpenzi…

ds:429:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But yes. I hilted the whole thing.

ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But really, for however small of a part you had to play, we thank you.
ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lakini kwa kweli, hata kama sehemu uliyosaidia ilikuwa ndogo kiasi gani, tunakushukuru.

ds:429:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok for real though, where are those cookies?
ds:429:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sawa, lakini kwa kweli, ziko wapi zile biskuti?

ds:42:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Are those for me? That was fast!

ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A deals a deal! Let me know when you’d like me to take you across the field!
ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Makubaliano ni makubaliano! Nijulishe unapotaka nikuvushe uwanjani!

ds:430:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey! How did the cookie delivery go?

ds:430:715:Dialogue Text.source:
It went great!
Everyone loved them!
ds:430:715:Dialogue Text.target:
Kulienda vizuri sana!
Kila mtu alizipenda!

ds:430:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do you think it broke the ice enough?
ds:430:717:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Unafikiri zimevunja barafu ya kufahamiana vya kutosha?

ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m not sure… you might need to
make more cookies to convince some…
ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.target:
Sina uhakika… huenda ukahitaji
kuoka biskuti zaidi kuwashawishi wengine…

ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.source:
No I’m just kidding.
Everyone’s very excited to meet you!
ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.target:
Hapana, natania tu.
Kila mtu ana hamu sana ya kukutana nawe!

ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oooh right... I guess the next step is to actually meet them...
ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oooh, kweli... Nadhani hatua inayofuata ni kukutana nao hasa...

ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ahhh! I'm not super great with meeting a lot of new critters at once...
ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ahhh! Sijui vizuri kukutana na wanyama wengi wapya kwa wakati mmoja...

ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve just got a lot of insecurities and anxieties…
ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nina hali nyingi tu za kutokujiamini na wasiwasi…

ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.source:
Absolutely. The critters are
very excited to meet you!
ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.target:
Kabisa. Wanyama wana
hamu sana ya kukutana nawe!

ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m sure I can keep them in check, but I’m definitely nervous!
ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nina hakika naweza kuzidhibiti, lakini hakika nina wasiwasi!

ds:430:728:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly, the critters are very talkative.
You could probably just listen and
nod your head and they’ll love you.
